## Automation Scientist

## About Chemify

Chemify is revolutionising chemistry. We are creating a future where the synthesis of previously unimaginable molecules, drugs, and materials is instantly accessible. By combining AI, robotics, and the world’s largest continually expanding database of chemical programs, we are accelerating chemical discovery to improve quality of life and extend the reach of humanity.

Our Chemifarm facility in Glasgow operates a growing fleet of advanced robotic systems that automate synthesis, optimisation, and library generation. This gives our computational scientists something rare: a direct, high-throughput bridge from in silico design to physically synthesised molecules, closing the design–make–test loop at a pace conventional drug discovery organisations cannot match.

**Location:** Glasgow, UK (on-site)

**Travel:** Minimal

## The Role

We are seeking an Automation Scientist to sit at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, and testing — translating real chemistry onto our robotic synthesis platform and making sure it works. You will take synthetic routes and turn them into automated protocols, run and validate them on our robotic systems, diagnose issues that span chemistry, hardware, firmware, and software, and feed what you learn back to the engineering teams building the platform.

What sets this role apart is the hybrid: you will need a chemist’s judgement, an engineer’s instinct for how the machines work, and a tester’s rigour — all on a platform where code becomes molecules.

If working across chemistry, engineering, and testing on a real-world robotic platform sounds like the right shape of job for you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

## Key Responsibilities

* Translate synthetic chemistry into automated protocols that run on our robotic platform.
* Run, validate, and troubleshoot syntheses end to end, diagnosing issues across chemistry, hardware, firmware, and software.
* Act as the bridge between the chemistry and engineering teams, turning lab reality into clear, actionable feedback.
* Define and run test protocols and acceptance criteria that prove the platform performs against real chemistry.
* Help characterise and improve platform capability, reliability, and reproducibility.
* Contribute to protocols, documentation, and the standards that make automated chemistry repeatable.

  **About You**

  You are a scientist who likes machines — as comfortable reasoning about a reaction as about the robot running it. You enjoy being the person who works out why something did not behave, whether the cause is chemistry, hardware, or code, and you communicate clearly across disciplines.

  ***We expect you to bring:***
* A degree in chemistry or a related science (PhD or equivalent hands-on experience welcome), with real synthetic / wet-lab experience.
* A strong practical bent and genuine interest in automation, robotics, and how the underlying systems work.

## Mechatronics Engineer

## About Chemify

Chemify is revolutionising chemistry. We are creating a future where the synthesis of previously unimaginable molecules, drugs, and materials is instantly accessible. By combining AI, robotics, and the world’s largest continually expanding database of chemical programs, we are accelerating chemical discovery to improve quality of life and extend the reach of humanity.

Our Chemifarm facility in Glasgow operates a growing fleet of advanced robotic systems that automate synthesis, optimisation, and library generation. This gives our computational scientists something rare: a direct, high-throughput bridge from in silico design to physically synthesised molecules, closing the design–make–test loop at a pace conventional drug discovery organisations cannot match.

**Location:** Glasgow, UK (on-site)

**Travel:** Minimal

## The Role

We are seeking a Mechatronics Engineer to work across the boundaries of our robotic synthesis platform — where mechanics, electronics, and firmware meet. You will design and integrate the motion and actuation systems that physically carry out chemistry, taking subsystems from concept through prototyping to reliable operation, and making sure the disciplines come together into hardware that just works.

What sets this role apart is the breadth: you will live at the interface of mechanical, electronic, and software design, on a platform where all three combine to turn code into molecules.

If working across mechanics, electronics, and firmware on a real-world robotic platform sounds like the right shape of job for you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

## Key Responsibilities

* Design and integrate mechatronic subsystems — motion, actuation, sensing — across mechanical, electronic, and firmware domains.
* Select and integrate motors, drives, sensors, and actuators, and tune them for real-world performance.
* Prototype, bring up, and test electromechanical systems, debugging across discipline boundaries.
* Partner with mechanical, electronics, firmware, and controls engineers to deliver integrated modules.
* Support characterisation, calibration, and reliability of motion and actuation systems.
* Contribute to design reviews and cross-disciplinary standards.

  **About You**

  You are a systems-minded engineer who is happiest where disciplines overlap. You can reason about a mechanism, the electronics that drive it, and the firmware that controls it, and you enjoy making them work together reliably in the real world.

  ***We expect you to bring:***
* Proven, significant experience in mechatronics, robotics, or electromechanical systems engineering.
* Working knowledge across at least two of: mechanical design, electronics, motion control, and embedded firmware.

**About Chemify**

Chemify is creating a future where important molecules, drugs and currently unimaginable new materials are instantly accessible; thereby radically increasing the speed of innovation, quality of life, and reach of humanity. The company is building the infrastructure to digitize chemistry for the design, discovery and synthesis of new molecules with the desired function and properties instantly and on-demand. Chemify has built a platform that combines purpose-built programming languages, robotics, AI, and the world's largest and continuously growing database of chemical programs to accelerate chemical discovery to new, transformative heights.

Chemify is supported by some of the best investors from Silicon Valley and across the world, including Triatomic Capital, BlueYard Ventures, DCVC, Founders Fund, and others.

**What we offer**

You'll join our analysis review team interpreting 1H-NMR and UPLC-MS data generated by our automated synthesis platform, playing a direct and critical role in keeping our chemistry pipeline moving. You'll also get exposure to a wide variety of organic chemistry reactions passing through the platform — genuinely interesting territory if you enjoy the puzzle of structure elucidation. This is an entry point into the synthetic chemistry industry, with full training provided. Working a shift pattern that includes evenings and weekends, you'll also earn a competitive uplift for unsocial hours on top of your base salary.

**Job purpose**

As our Analysis Review Scientist, you will review and interpret 1H-NMR and UPLC-MS data produced by our automated chemistry platform, confirming that reactions and purifications have produced the expected outcome, flagging anomalies for further investigation, and generating high-quality reports. This is a computer-based role, working with digital spectra and data files rather than at the bench. The role follows a structured, repeatable process across a high volume of samples each shift, and forms part of a rota that includes evenings and weekends to keep pace with round-the-clock synthesis.

**Who we are looking for**

We're looking for an entry-level scientist — ideal for a recent chemistry graduate or someone early in their career — who is comfortable with focused, detail-oriented work performed to a consistent standard. You'll have a working knowledge of 1H-NMR and mass spectrometry from your studies or lab experience, a methodical approach to spotting when something doesn't match expectations, and the flexibility to work a rota that includes evenings and weekends. Strong communication matters too: you'll work closely with our synthesis program manager team on interpreting outcomes, and may occasionally liaise with the operations team when troubleshooting instrument or pipeline issues.

**Key responsibilities**

• Data interpretation: Review 1H-NMR spectra and UPLC-MS traces against expected reaction and purification outcomes, confirming success or diagnosing likely products and where a reaction may have gone wrong, to help inform future runs.

• Volume and turnaround: Process a high throughput of samples each shift to keep pace with the automated synthesis platform, maintaining consistent accuracy and speed.

• Shift coverage: Work a rota that includes evenings and weekends, providing near-continuous data turnaround for the chemistry team.

• Escalation: Flag ambiguous or unexpected spectra to senior scientists for further review, and report issues with the software platform or automated processing and verification steps.

• Record keeping: Maintain accurate, consistent records of interpretations and decisions in line with SOPs.

• Quality and compliance: Follow SOPs and quality procedures for data review and support timely investigation of flagged discrepancies or audit findings.

• Continuous improvement: Feedback patterns or recurring issues you spot to help refine interpretation guidelines over time, collaborating cross-functionally in line with one of Chemify's core values.

Chichester Harbour is an exceptional site for wildlife and is globally important for migratory birds. The harbour has multiple designations to protect its landscape, habitats and wildlife. It became an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty in 1964 (now known as a National Landscape), a Site of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI) in 1970, a Special Protection Area (SPA) in 1979, a RAMSAR site in1987, and a Special Area of Conservation (SAC) in 1994. The designated features within Chichester Harbour include the intertidal habitats of saltmarsh, seagrass and mudflats, along with the wintering bird assemblage and nesting bird populations.

However, Chichester Harbour has not escaped the wider declining state of nature seen across the UK and beyond. In 2021, Natural England’s Condition Review downgraded the main Chichester Harbour SSSI to ‘unfavourable declining’ condition.

In response to the Condition Review, Chichester Harbour Conservancy founded the Chichester Harbour Protection and Recovery of Nature  (CHaPRoN) partnership to lead our nature recovery efforts and restore Chichester Harbour back to favourable condition by 2050. The partnership is driving forward a suite of initiatives to reduce the pressures on the natural environment, by actively restoring intertidal habitats whilst also increasing resilience to climate change.

To support this work, Chichester Harbour Conservancy has successfully secured a grant from The National Lottery Heritage Fund for vital project development work to invest in our nature recovery efforts. In 18 months’ time, a larger application to the Heritage Fund’s Landscape Connections initiative will be submitted to help pay for the delivery of these projects as they move to the implementation phase.

We are recruiting a Project Manager to lead with the development work for the Chichester Harbour Landscape Connections project. The role will deliver the components of the Heritage Fund project in accordance with the funding bid and approved expenditure. This will include commissioning Feasibility Studies/Technical Reports,  developing an Access, Inclusion and Participation plan to increase community connectivity with our nature recovery work and seeking all required permissions, licences and consents in support of project delivery.

**For full details of the role, please see the attached job description. If you would like to discuss the role in advance of applying, please contact Nicky Simmons at recruitment@conservancy.co.uk in the first instance who will arrange for a colleague to contact you.**

**To apply please complete the CHC application form and email your application to: recruitment@conservancy.co.uk.**

**Closing date: Monday 26th October 2026 at 12pm. Interviews to be held: 5th/6th November.**

This is an exciting opportunity to join a conservation body that is helping to restore the natural environment within Chichester Harbour and safeguard the future of this precious National Landscape.

Using money raised by National Lottery players, The National Lottery Heritage Fund supports projects that connect people and communities with the UK’s heritage. The Chichester Harbour Landscapes Connection Project  is made possible with The National Lottery Heritage Fund. Thanks to National Lottery players, we are able to recruit a Project Manager and complete vital project development work to support our nature recovery efforts.*

## About the role

Our customers are building AI products where a wrong value is not an embarrassment but a harm: a missed allergen, an exercise that aggravates an injury, a drug interaction not flagged. They do not need another vector database. They need to be able to say, with evidence, why a value is what it is.

This role decides what we build next for them. That means talking to those teams, understanding the field that actually has to be right, and turning it into slices an engineer can start on Monday, including the acceptance criteria for what must fail closed and what must be provable from a receipt.

The scarce skill here is saying no. The product surface wants to widen constantly (more input formats, more connectors, more knobs) and most of that should wait until the current slice is honest.

## What you'd do

* Talk to teams building on safety-critical catalogs and turn what you hear into slices an engineer can start on Monday
* Own the pipeline end to end as a product: inputs, contracts, curation, release, the deployed tool and its security settings
* Write the acceptance criteria, including what must fail closed and what must be provable from a receipt
* Say no to work that widens the surface before the current slice is honest
* Keep the public roadmap and the site accurate about what is built versus what is planned

## What we need

* Four or more years in product, at least some of it on a technical or developer-facing product
* You can read an API contract and hold your own in a design discussion with engineers
* You write specs that are specific enough to argue with, including the edge cases
* You have killed or cut a feature you liked, and can explain the call
* Comfortable enough with SQL to answer your own questions about usage

## Nice to have, not required

* Background in data quality, catalog management, search or retrieval
* You have worked with a regulated customer and survived a security review
* You have written developer documentation people actually used

## How we work

* Small team, thin slices, shipped weekly. Nothing sits on a branch for a month.
* Reviews are real. Every feature ships with its tests, and a bug found in review is cheaper than one found by a customer.
* Safety-critical means the boring answer usually wins: fail closed, keep the receipt, don't guess.
* We only claim what ships. That applies to the product, the roadmap and the offer letter.

## How hiring works

1. 1A 30-minute call about something you've built and what was hard about it.
2. 2A working session on a real problem from this codebase. You can drive, or we can pair.
3. 3A conversation about how you make decisions when the evidence is thin.
4. 4References, then an offer. We aim to answer within a week at every stage.

## Apply

Tell us about something you've built and what was hard about it. That says more than a CV, and we read every one. Prefer email? support@cloudcrane.in.

# Research Fellow - Political Process Preferences in Europe (PoPPiE) project

**Full Time Fixed Term for 36 months**

We are delighted to welcome applications for the position of Research Fellow within a new ERC-funded research group on Political Process Preferences in Europe (PoPPiE): Rethinking Conceptual, Ontological and Methodological Foundations (https://poppieproject.com/).

The project aims to develop new ways of understanding how citizens and other political actors think their political institutions should function. Existing surveys like the European Social Survey show extremely strong support for liberal democratic values across Europe, yet people are increasingly voting for far-right parties that reject exactly these values.

To make sense of this conundrum, we need to shift away from researching democratic attitudes as a choice between alternative normative models of democracy, such as representative democracy versus direct democracy. Instead, we require an approach that is psychologically more realistic and more closely approximates the reality of the complex democratic systems we inhabit, which do not correspond to the neat conceptual delineations of democratic theories.

The post holder will take a prominent role in developing the conceptual and methodological innovations to create and operationalise the new approach by designing, conducting and analysing original survey research. This will involve connecting with the projects qualitative work, for instance; focus groups and cognitive interviewing to better understand the nature and content of political process preferences, then using the insights from this work to create survey experiments that will test the new approach. The post-holder will take a role in all stages of this process, from conceptualisation to data collection and analysis, as well as writing up and presenting the findings. As such, there is scope for the post-holder to bring their own skills and interests to influence the direction of the research.

This research position will be based in the Department of Politics and International Relations within the Faculty of Social Sciences, at the University of Southampton, and the work will be carried out under the supervision of Rikki Dean (principal investigator of the project). You will join a vibrant Department with a high concentration of scholars at all career levels researching related themes in the Public Opinion Research Network and the Centre for Behavioural, Experimental and Action Research. The position also comes with its own budget for travel and professional development.

To be successful you will have completed your PhD in a relevant (or equivalent professional qualifications). You will have: a strong background in survey research, with previous experience of survey experiments desirable; a track record of research on the political attitudes of the public and/or other key political actors; a facility for solving conceptual and methodological problems; the ability to plan and organise work independently and as part of a team; the ability to write research presentations and papers for peer-reviewed publication. * Oversee the scoping and budgeting of new productions, working with Producers and creative leads to establish the right approach, team, schedule and cost.

### Resourcing

### Freelance Production

Act as the senior production contact across Art&Graft’s key client accounts, providing continuity across multiple projects and Producers and ensuring knowledge and learnings are carried from one production to the next.

Take ownership of incoming production briefs from existing clients, helping define requirements and allocating projects to the appropriate Producer and team.

Support Producers with senior client conversations, negotiations, escalations and difficult project situations, ensuring clients experience Art&Graft as one joined-up production team.

# FP&A Manager

**We are Creditspring, a new way of borrowing that focuses on its members and provides them with safe and efficient short-term financial products.**

We're a fast-growing FCA-regulated consumer credit company. We have members, not customers and we take a lot of pride in that!

As one of the UK’s only subscription finance company in the market, we truly have a unique value proposition. Our mission is very clear; to improve the financial stability and resilience of our members. We do this through the products we provide, the partnerships we have, and our educational content. We want our members, and everyone in the UK to be able to better manage their finances and steer them away from high-cost, unregulated credit options.

**About the role**

Our planning capability has reached an important point in its development. We have built a plan that can reliably predict performance; the next step is to evolve this into a broader commercial decision-support capability that can support the business through its next phase, including a potential exit process.

Reporting to the Senior FP&A & Capital Markets Manager, this role will take ownership of the analytics that underpin some of our most important commercial decisions, from pricing and cohort economics to understanding the trade-offs between growth, profitability and losses. You will also strengthen our operating model so that it can withstand the demands of diligence, be rapidly rebuilt under multiple scenarios, and reconcile confidently to audited financials and lender reporting.

This is a deliberately commercial role. It is not simply about reporting performance or administering a budget. We are looking for someone who will develop a point of view, challenge assumptions and use data to influence decisions. You will turn the plan from a spreadsheet exercise into an operating discipline that helps shape how we run and grow the business.

**Responsibilities**

* **Own the integrated operating model.**Take end-to-end ownership of the three-statement operating model, ensuring its integrity, documentation, version control and audit trail, with clear reconciliation to the general ledger, management reporting and lender reporting.
* **Lead planning and forecasting.** Run the annual budget and reforecast cycles from assumption-setting through challenge and finalisation, partnering with the Head of FP&A and Capital Markets on key assumptions and plan sign-off.
* **Turn performance into insight.** Own monthly actual versus plan analysis, identifying the underlying causes and commercial consequences of performance rather than simply reporting variances. Produce clear, decision-focused reporting for Exco and the Board.
* **Embed financial ownership across the business.** Build and maintain department-level budgets, partner with functional leaders to understand performance against plan, and establish consistent KPI definitions across management, Board, lender and data reporting.
* **Own unit economics and pricing analytics**. Develop cohort-level understanding of acquisition cost, revenue, interest income, losses, retention, contribution and payback, alongside pricing analytics covering elasticity, product mix, margins, credit quality and customer retention.
* **Evaluate commercial and product decisions**. Build the financial case for pricing changes, commercial initiatives and product tests, and provide rigorous post-implementation analysis to determine whether expected outcomes were delivered.
* **Lead scenario modelling and strategic decision support.** Quantify the trade-offs between growth, profitability, loss rates and excess spread, including modelling funding capacity and covenant headroom with Treasury. Translate alternative strategies into clear risk-and-return choices for the CFO and CEO.
* **Build a scalable FP&A capability**. Manage and develop a Business Analyst, automate reporting and planning processes, and establish clear ownership and deadlines across FP&A deliverables. Create a function where analyst capacity is increasingly focused on insight and decision support rather than data assembly.

**What you'll need to succeed****Essential**

* Strong financial modelling capability: able to build an integrated three statement model from a blank sheet and defend every driver in it.
* Working fluency in credit and funding mechanics: loss curves, excess spread, net interest margin, advance rates, covenant headroom.
* Commercial analytics experience: pricing, cohort economics, retention, contribution margin, test design and read out.
* Able to give a direct answer to a senior stakeholder and hold a position under challenge.

**Desirable**

* Experience through a transaction process and of a model being subjected to diligence.
* SQL and Power BI, or equivalent, and comfort working directly with a data team on source definitions.
* Consumer credit or fintech environment.
* First line management experience.
* Lending business experience.
* Qualified accountant or equivalent analytical background (CFA, economics, engineering, mathematics). Qualification matters less than modelling and commercial judgement.  
    
    
  Don’t meet all the listed requirements? Research shows that women and people of underrepresented groups often don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% qualified. As an equal opportunities employer, we know that diversity is a key part of our teams' successes - so if your experience doesn’t fit perfectly but this role excites you, we’d love for you to apply. We’re committed to Creditspring being an inclusive environment where employees feel welcomed, valued and listened to; we want you to thrive as your true self.  
    
  Please note that the People Team is contactable only via people@creditspring.co. Unsolicited emails to other team members will not be actioned

* **Monthly Reporting Support:** Assist with pulling base operational data and preparing raw records for the monthly People Pack and executive reporting suites.
* **Ad-hoc Projects:** Participate in broader People Operations projects, process reviews, and system improvement initiatives.

# Deep Learning Research Engineer Intern

DataRobot R&D is a hard-working, fast-moving, fun-loving team of developers who put products before pride.

Apply now

**Job Description:**

DataRobot delivers AI that maximizes impact and minimizes business risk. Our platform and applications integrate into core business processes so teams can develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. DataRobot empowers practitioners to deliver predictive and generative AI, and enables leaders to secure their AI assets. Organizations worldwide rely on DataRobot for AI that makes sense for their business — today and in the future. 

This effort is about building a multi-target joint probabilistic foundation model that can be used across industries to tackle some of the hardest real-world problems. The ambition goes beyond what tabular and time-series foundation models usually do: one model should support temporal forecasting, unordered tabular regression and classification, missing-data completion, and mixed-modality inputs and outputs while learning coherent joint structure across connected variables, rows, horizons, and scenarios. The primary objective is to create real value in serious use cases rather than optimize benchmark scores in isolation, although strong results on standard benchmarks are expected to follow closely.

  

This role is designed as a research-engineering internship for someone operating at post-doctoral level, or very close to it, who wants to shape the architecture of a probabilistic foundation model. The center of gravity is the model itself: the encoders that read temporal, tabular, and mixed-modality inputs, the attention and sequence mechanisms that carry structure across variables, rows, and horizons, and the distributional output heads and decoding schemes that turn hidden states into coherent joint predictions. We are looking for someone who can reason precisely about what an architecture can and cannot represent, and who then implements, trains, and evaluates the resulting PyTorch models in a production-quality codebase. A background in stochastic modeling is a strong plus rather than a prerequisite: the model is trained on synthetic data drawn from stochastic dynamics, so a candidate who can also reason about stochastic differential equations and design synthetic data generators can contribute on both sides of the training loop.

  

**Required Skills:**

  

* Strong PyTorch skills and hands-on experience building and training deep models.
* Solid understanding of Transformers, attention variants, and long-context or state-space sequence architectures, including the tradeoffs between quality, memory, and latency.
* Experience with probabilistic modeling in neural networks: distributional output heads, likelihood-based or proper-scoring-rule losses, mixture or flow models, or related uncertainty-aware learning setups.
* Strong foundation in probability and statistics, enough to reason about densities and masses, dependence between variables, and calibration.
* Ability to connect architectural ideas to working GPU-native implementations, controlled experiments, and diagnostics that show why a change helped.
* Strong engineering habits: readable code, tests, reproducible experiments, and disciplined evaluation of model changes.
* Ability to debug training instability, reason about why results changed, and iterate quickly from hypothesis to evidence.

  

**Strong Plus:**

  

* Working knowledge of stochastic processes and stochastic differential equations: drift and diffusion, jumps, regime switching, mean reversion, heavy tails, and how such dynamics are simulated numerically.
* Experience designing synthetic data generators or simulation-based training curricula, and an understanding of how the training distribution shapes what a model learns.
* Depth in a domain with rich stochastic structure such as finance, energy, commodities, or a similarly quantitative field.
* Familiarity with tabular or mixed-modality deep learning: categorical, ordinal, count, and bounded targets alongside continuous ones.

  

**What You Can Expect To Work On:**

  

* Designing and improving the core model architecture: input encoders for temporal, unordered tabular, and mixed-modality data; attention factorizations across variables, rows, and horizons; the distributional output heads and decoding strategies that produce coherent joint samples.
* Running controlled architecture studies, from ablations and scaling behavior to memory and throughput profiles, and turning the results into design decisions.
* Building scalable PyTorch implementations that support larger input and output spaces, better throughput, and tighter memory budgets.
* Studying how architectural choices, data-generation choices, and inference constraints interact to change benchmark quality and real-world usefulness.
* For candidates with the stochastic-modeling background: extending the synthetic-data engine with richer stochastic dynamics, constraints, dependence structures, heavy tails, and regime behavior.
* Turning research ideas into robust implementations and credible empirical results.

  

**What You Should Expect:**

  

* Work that sits close to the core of the project rather than at the edges.
* A fast research loop where good ideas can move quickly from hypothesis to implementation to benchmark.
* A real chance to contribute to research that aims for top-tier, state-of-the-art outcomes rather than only incremental internal work.
* A team that values rigorous thinking, clean code, and practical usefulness at the same time.
* Exposure to problems that combine deep learning, stochastic modeling, and real deployment constraints instead of isolating only one of those dimensions.
* A role that fits someone with broad interests who wants to work across both advanced modeling and serious implementation work rather than staying narrowly specialized.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.
We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.
This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.
We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.
This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.
What you'll do:
Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.

1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).

## Job description

A Digibee está contratando um(a) **Cloud Security Engineer** para o time de Segurança, cobrindo uma posição estratégica na área. Essa pessoa será responsável por levar segurança para dentro do ciclo de desenvolvimento e entrega de software (DevSecOps), atuando diretamente nos pipelines de CI/CD, na gestão e governança de vulnerabilidades e na definição de imagens de container seguras (hardening, Wolfi/Chainguard, distroless) para a plataforma, que roda em Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

É uma posição técnica de referência (nível Especialista): define padrões de segurança em nuvem e pipeline que os demais times técnicos seguem, trabalhando lado a lado com Engenharia, SRE e Plataforma — sem deter autoridade hierárquica sobre eles.

## Responsibilities and assignments

* Integrar controles de segurança nos pipelines de CI/CD (SAST, SCA, scanning de imagens, SBOM, assinatura/verificação de imagens), tornando segurança parte do fluxo de entrega em vez de um gate manual no final.
* Avaliar, definir e conduzir o rollout de imagens de container hardened (Wolfi/Chainguard, distroless), reduzindo superfície de ataque e CVEs nas imagens base usadas pela engenharia.
* Liderar a gestão e governança de vulnerabilidades: priorização baseada em risco, SLAs de remediação e acompanhamento com os times de engenharia até o fechamento.
* Projetar e implementar controles de segurança em infraestrutura GCP (IAM, redes, Artifact Registry, políticas de organização), em conjunto com Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
* Atuar como referência técnica em segurança de pipeline e cloud, orientando squads de engenharia em práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (shift-left) sem travar a velocidade de entrega.
* Colaborar com SRE em observabilidade e resiliência com a lente de segurança (hardening de runtime, resposta a incidentes, postura de produção).
* Executar testes pontuais no formato de pentest para validar controles e remediações, em complemento aos engajamentos formais de pentest com fornecedores externos.
* Apoiar auditorias e requisitos de compliance (SOC2, PCI) relacionados a pipeline, vulnerabilidades e imagens.

## Requirements and qualifications

* 5+ anos de experiência em Cloud Security Engineering, DevSecOps ou Security Engineering, com atuação prática em ambientes de produção.
* Domínio de Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — IAM, redes, Artifact Registry, políticas de segurança de organização.
* Experiência prática integrando segurança em pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins ou similares) e com ferramentas de vulnerability scanning (ex.: Trivy, Snyk, Wiz).
* Experiência com Docker/Kubernetes em produção: multi-stage builds, hardening de runtime, non-root execution, gestão de dependências.
* Conhecimento de imagens de container seguras/hardened (Wolfi, Chainguard, distroless), ou forte apetite para se especializar nisso.
* Scripting sólido em Python e/ou Bash para automação de controles de segurança.
* Entendimento de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (secure SDLC, OWASP Top 10, threat modeling básico).
* Vivência com práticas de SRE (observabilidade, confiabilidade, incident response) suficiente para colaborar tecnicamente com o time de SRE.
* Boa comunicação técnica para influenciar squads de engenharia sem autoridade hierárquica direta.

  
Diferenciais:  

* Certificações como Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), ou equivalentes.

# Senior OT Security Analyst

United Kingdom

At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

**About the Role**: 

As a Senior OT Security Analyst on the OT Watch Complete team, you will help lead a frontline monitoring and triage unit responsible for identifying potential adversary activity in customer operational technology (OT) environments. You will work closely with other experienced industrial defenders and mentor junior analysts to investigate anomalous network behaviors, validate detection triggers, and support threat hunters and incident responders with high-quality escalations. You will also operate and maintain the Dragos platform on behalf of customers, helping manage vulnerabilities, tune detections, properly classify OT assets, and provide input on response recommendations. This is a great opportunity for experienced cybersecurity professionals — especially those passionate about industrial security — to build hands-on experience in active OT security operations.

**Responsibilities**: 

* Lead shift operations, guiding analysts as they triage detection alerts and network telemetry from the Dragos Platform across customer OT environments — stepping in as shift leader for your region when needed.
* Serve as a senior investigator, digging into suspicious activity to identify misconfigurations, anomalies, and potential malicious behavior across industrial networks.

**Help Investors and Businesses Create Value**

Looking for a graduate role where you'll gain exposure to private equity, business strategy, client advisory and commercial decision-making from day one?

 

Join Howden Private Capital (HPC), a newly established global division serving private equity, private credit, infrastructure and institutional investor clients. As a Graduate Analyst in Portfolio Solutions, you'll work with investors and portfolio companies, helping deliver solutions that support growth, manage risk and create long-term value.

 

Unlike many graduate roles, this position offers broad exposure to private capital clients, business development activities and strategic projects. You'll support client initiatives, market research, commercial analysis and relationship management while working closely with colleagues across Howden and senior stakeholders in the private capital market.

 

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is commercially minded, enjoys working with people and is interested in how investors create value in businesses.

 

This is a permanent role supported by a structured 18-month development programme, designed to accelerate your professional confidence, commercial understanding and long-term career growth.

 

**What you’ll be doing?**

You'll begin with a structured induction before joining the Portfolio Solutions team, where you'll work directly with senior leaders across the business.

During the programme, you’ll:

  

* Research private equity funds, investors and portfolio companies.

* Support the development of solutions for private capital clients.

* Prepare client presentations, reports and market insights.

* Analyse business and portfolio company data.

* Support business development and client relationship activities.

* Work with teams across Howden to deliver solutions for clients.

* Attend client meetings and prepare briefing materials.

* Contribute to strategic projects and commercial initiatives.

**Who are we looking for?**

**No insurance experience is needed; we’ll teach you everything you need to know!**

  

**You'll be:**

* A recent graduate, or in your final year of university study.

* Curious about business, investing and commercial strategy.

* Interested in private equity, financial services, consulting or client advisory.

* A strong communicator who enjoys building relationships.

* Analytical, commercially minded and naturally curious.

* Organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

* Someone who takes ownership and enjoys learning.

* A collaborative team player.

To be eligible for our programme, you must have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK.

* **Online gamified assessment:** We’ve created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best!
* **Pre-recorded video interview:** You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.
* **Assessment centre:** Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day, because where you are now, shouldn’t hold back your future!

At Howden, people are at the heart of everything we do. As an employee-owned business, we believe success is built through collaboration, learning and supporting one another. You'll join a permanent role from day one and take part in our structured 18-month development programme, designed to accelerate your technical, commercial and professional growth.

* A starting salary of £40,000 and a generous pension scheme.

* Opportunity to complete fully funded professional qualifications, such as the CII or CFA, to support your long-term career development.

* Access to discounted personal health policies, wellbeing support and a range of employee benefits and insurance products.

* 2 days allocated to take part in volunteering schemes.

You'll find resources to help you prepare for our recruitment process and understand which career path could be the best fit for you.

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

# Upstream Analyst

We are seeking an Upstream oil and gas analyst to enhance our coverage of the global upstream oil and gas industry based out of London or Vienna. The role will be multi-faceted and will focus on maintaining and improving our global crude, condensate and gas production models for the short and medium term.

You will join a team of oil and gas experts to closely monitor and assess key events and commercial developments in oil and gas, gathering and analysing industry data. You will lean on a strong analytical foundation to build views of productivity and costs, mostly for conventional assets globally.

A successful candidate will play an active role in the full cycle of research, conducting corporate analysis across the energy value chain and enhancing our forecasts. You will also form opinions on corporate strategies, midstream infrastructure, M&A deals, energy transition, petroleum economics, government energy policy and regional geopolitics.

You will be highly resourceful and call on a wide range of sources to feed into your analysis. You are comfortable and efficient at manipulating data, building forecast models, carrying out detailed analysis, writing compelling reports, and presenting our views to clients.

Our clients value our views and insights, so you will help shape forward-looking views rather than conduct solely historical analysis. You will be expected to consistently produce high-quality work to send to our demanding client base which ranges from traders to strategy departments to the c-suite. We pride ourselves on our product. We are meticulous about maintaining a high standard across our services and will ensure adequate training and support is provided to help achieve this.

This position will require flexibility and the drive to go beyond core hours when needed to ensure we all achieve our goals. You will be in constant communication with the market team and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and integration of data. All team members are encouraged to build their professional reputation within the energy sector and are supported by some of the most well-regarded commentators in the global energy industry.

## Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain production forecasts for crude oil, condensate, and gas production, ensuring alignment with market trends and company objectives.
* Assess the impact of outages, sanctions, or other events on production, providing timely insights.
* Maintain and update projects databases, ensuring all data related to exploration, development, and production projects is current and accurate.
* Model field-level production profiles to predict future production rates.
* Analyse company financial statements to extract key valuation metrics and assess where future opportunities lie in the energy market.
* Manage regular updates of upstream data files as part of client data service.
* Visualise data to serve the wider research team and work with the data team to enhance client data offerings.
* Contribute to and enrich existing research publications.
* Continuously seek to increase your market knowledge and widen your network of contacts.

* At least 3 years of experience in the oil and gas industry, with a focus on forecasting, data management, or production analysis.
* Strong attention to detail in both handling data and written English.
* Excellent technical skills using excel.
* Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively with others (including colleagues in different time zones) to deliver timely analysis.
* Proactive and commercially minded.

**Desirable skills:**

* Degree in Geoscience, Engineering, Economics or a related field.
* Experience in infrastructure mapping using Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and satellite imagery analysis would be beneficial.
* Experience in financial modelling or economic analysis within the upstream oil and gas sector

The company is repurposing some of its existing infrastructure, including depleted reservoirs that have held natural gas for millions of years, to support economic growth in the region and help the UK achieve its Net Zero objectives. In this full-time role, you will take direct operational ownership of our ticketing lifecycles across both our Owned & Operated (O&O) events and publisher partnerships. You will bridge backend inventory setup, onsite entrance operations, and commercial upsell strategies - ensuring seamless fan entry, maximizing revenue across channels, and driving high repeat purchase rates, all while gathering critical data to continuously improve our products.



## Core Responsibilities & What You Will Do

### 1. Event Launch & Platform Operations

* **End-to-End Setup:** Drive end-to-end ticketing setup and execution across both Owned & Operated (O&O) and publisher-led esports events.
* **Platform Configuration:** Configure and launch ticket waves, pricing tiers, promo codes, add-ons, and promotional campaigns across ticketing platforms, ensuring 100% backend accuracy.
* **Launch Briefings:** Deliver Event Launch Briefings and forms to Customer Support, marketing, and local event teams to guarantee frictionless, fully-aligned go-lives.

### 2. Onsite Venue & Access Management

* **Entrance Logistics:** Lead onsite entrance operations (gate logistics, scanner configuration, staff briefings, accreditation flow) to minimize queue times and friction.
* **Fan Arrival Experience:** Optimize the fan arrival experience to boost satisfaction and drive high repeat purchase rates for future events.
* **Live Event Link:** Act as the operational link between central commerce strategy and local venue teams during live event days.

### 3. Premium Inventory & Commercial Upsell

* **Inventory Allocation:** Manage and allocate premium channel inventories, including VIP packages, hospitality, early access, and merchandise bundles.
* **Funnel Upselling:** Execute dynamic upsell and cross-sell strategies throughout the customer purchase funnel to maximize yield and conversion.
* **Pacing & Adjustments:** Monitor sales pacing, adjusting inventory availability strategically based on real-time demand.

### 4. Customer Insights & Post-Mortem Analysis

* **Escalations & Support:** Partner directly with Customer Support to resolve second-tier ticket resolutions, identify recurring customer pain points, and compile updated FAQs for live events.
* **Qualitative Data Analysis:** Analyze qualitative feedback, combining ticket support trends with NPS survey sentiment to uncover actionable operational insights.
* **Post-Mortem Retrospectives:** Deliver Post-Mortem Retrospectives after major events, feeding data back to Product and Ops teams to continuously refine future events.

### 5. Process Optimization & Operational Excellence

* **Workflow Management:** Own Monday.com project workflows, maintaining strict data hygiene, tracking task dependencies, and ensuring cross-team visibility across inventory and project timelines.
* **Automations & Improvements:** Implement smart automations within project management tools to streamline execution and optimize daily team operational efficiency.
* **Proactive Upgrades:** Self-identify operational deficiencies and proactively suggest process improvements to the team and relevant stakeholders.

## Requirements

* **Proven Experience:** Experience in Ticketing Operations, E-commerce Operations, Live Event execution, or Box Office/Access Management roles is strongly preferred (particularly in gaming).
* **Technical & Analytical Proficiency:** Advanced skills in Excel / Google Sheets (data manipulation, formulas, pivot tables) and proficiency in building clear presentations in PowerPoint / Google Slides.
* **Data Hygiene & Detail Orientation:** Demonstrated ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative data (NPS sentiment, support ticket volume) with a zero-error mindset for backend configurations.
* **Communication & Onsite Operations:** Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate operational details smoothly with internal teams, local venue staff, and external suppliers.
* **Problem-Solving under Pressure:** Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks independently and make quick, practical operational decisions on live event days.
* **Languages:** Fluent in English and at least one additional language.
* **Mobility:** Able and willing to travel internationally (potentially 3-4 events a year max).
* **Esports Expertise:** Extensive experience in esports at least as a player/spectator, preferably in *Counter-Strike*, *Dota 2*, or *Call of Duty*.

### Nice to Have

* **Platform & System Setup:** Direct experience configuring (SaaS) ticketing backend engines (pricing waves, promo codes, gate access rules) and operating access control scanning hardware/software onsite.
* **Tool Mastery:** Hands-on experience with project management platforms (Monday.com or similar) and customer support/ticketing systems (Zendesk or similar).
* **Commercial & Inventory Execution:** Solid understanding of e-commerce mechanics, inventory allocation, and dynamic upsell/cross-sell execution (e.g., VIP bundles, add-ons).

## Hypothetical Breakdown of the Role and Responsibilities

* **Event Setup & Platform Launch Execution (O&O & Publisher):** 35%
* **Venue Entrance Operations & Onsite Access Support:** 25%
* **Premium Inventory Configuration & Upsell Execution:** 20%
* **Customer Support Alignment, NPS Analysis & Post-Mortem Reporting:** 20%

## Who You Are

* **Clear Communicator:** You are a strong communicator, capable of clearly coordinating complex operational details between internal teams, publisher partners, venue staff, and Customer Support.
* **Commercial & Fan-Centric Mindset:** You possess a commercial mindset and care deeply about the fan journey - ensuring a seamless purchasing process, maximizing upsell opportunities across premium products, and delivering smooth venue arrivals.

* **Cool Under Pressure:** You thrive in hands-on live event environments, keeping a cool head under pressure when managing gate flows, onsite access control, or live ticket launch waves.

Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world's largest and most prestigious employers. We‘re about fuller plates, fuller communities, and fuller lives.

**Purpose of the Job** 

We are looking for a Junior to Mid-level Analytics Engineer who wants to grow into someone who can do three things equally well: build and maintain the data models that reporting sits on, work with people to understand what they actually need, and use AI-assisted tooling as a normal part of how the work gets done. You don't need to arrive doing all three confidently — you need to be strong in analysis and reporting today, and genuinely keen to develop into the modelling and engineering side with support from the team.

You will be part of the bridge between our small data team and the rest of the organisation. That means turning agreed requirements into reliable, well-modelled data and the reports that sit on top of it, working with our Impact & Insights colleagues who own metric definitions and outcome frameworks rather than duplicating that work.

The majority of the role sits on the platform side — building and maintaining the Bronze/Silver/Gold model alongside the Data Engineer, restructuring the data lake, and documenting what exists. Alongside that, you will support requirements and reporting work with business teams, so that what gets built reflects what people actually need. You will contribute to the team's data models, documentation and governance as we consolidate two organisations onto a shared Microsoft Fabric platform — and you will do it using the AI-assisted tools and workflows the team has adopted as standard, under a peer-review safety gate, which is also where a lot of your own learning will happen.

You will report to the BI Lead and work closely with our Data Engineer, who you'll pair with regularly as you build up the modelling and engineering side of the role. The team is small and deliberately focused — we aim to do fewer things better, rather than spread thin across every request.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

## Data modelling and engineering (primary focus)

* Start contributing to work in the Fabric Lakehouse alongside the Data Engineer — supporting Bronze/Silver/Gold transformations before progressing to building and refactoring them independently.
* Write documented, testable logic for the pieces you own, growing into more complex transformation work as your confidence builds.
* Learn dimensional modelling in practice (fact/dimension design, star schemas) through paired work with the Data Engineer, rather than being expected to make these calls solo from day one.
* Help identify manual Excel-based consolidation processes across departments as candidates for automation, working with the Data Engineer to replace them.

## Requirements and business partnering (supporting the wider process)

* Support requirements-gathering sessions with teams across Felix — including finance, fundraising operations, operations and distribution, food sourcing and digital marketing — working within the agreed triage process and alongside the Impact & Insights team rather than in parallel with it.
* Help translate agreed business requirements into clear, achievable technical briefs, learning when to flag constructively where requests outpace available data or team capacity.
* Maintain visibility of what is being built, for whom, and why — supporting the team as a technical point of contact for reporting and data requests routed through the agreed triage process.
* Help manage expectations around timelines, data limitations and priorities, communicating changes clearly and proactively.

## Reporting and dashboards

* Design, build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that are accurate, well-documented and genuinely adopted by the teams they serve.
* Ensure reports are built on solid, governed data foundations rather than ad-hoc workarounds.
* Implement agreed KPI definitions consistently across models and reports, and keep the shared data glossary up to date as definitions are signed off.

## AI-augmented delivery

* **Use AI-assisted tooling as a normal part of the workflow from day one** — Copilot-style code and DAX assistance, LLM-assisted documentation, and MCP-based agentic tools — with the team showing you how, in line with the permissive-but-reviewed approach.
* **Develop judgement about when not to trust generated output**: you'll be taught how to verify a model, a measure or a piece of documentation an AI tool produced, and everything goes through peer review before it reaches production, stakeholders or decisions — this is part of how you'll learn, not just a safety check.
* Contribute observations to the team's shared practice around AI-assisted work as you build experience with it.
* Work AI tools iteratively rather than one-shot — refine a brief, check the output against the source data, loop back and improve it, rather than taking the first draft a model gives you and moving on. This applies whether you're writing DAX, drafting documentation or preparing a stakeholder brief.

## Data quality and governance

* Flag data quality issues as you encounter them and trace them to their source, working with the Data Engineer where needed.
* Document your models, reports, calculations and assumptions clearly so that others can understand, challenge and build on your work.
* Support consistent naming conventions, metadata practices and ownership models as part of the team's broader governance effort.

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

Working across Marketing and Issuer & Investor Relations, the Marketing and Audience Development Manager will develop and deliver lead-generation, acquisition and engagement activity across events, webinars, content and digital campaigns.

This role combines hands-on marketing delivery with an audience-first and commercially minded approach. Using data and insight, you’ll help identify the audiences we need to reach, determine how best to engage them and uncover opportunities to grow our issuer and investor communities and support the commercial growth of our events.

* Build year-round engagement activity that maintains relationships with key communities between individual event campaigns.
* Find opportunities to re-engage existing or dormant audiences and strengthen their relationship with the wider portfolio.
* Test new acquisition and engagement approaches, scaling activity that delivers high-quality and commercially relevant leads.
* Plan and deliver multi-channel campaigns across email, digital, social media, website, content, partnerships and other relevant channels.

# Head of Corporate Learning and Education (London)

##### About Fresha

##### Fresha is the **leading AI-powered operating system for the global beauty and wellness industry,** giving businesses everything they need to run smarter, grow faster and build stronger client relationships.

In May 2026, Fresha secured an **$80M growth investment from KKR at a valuation of $1B**, officially reaching unicorn status and bringing total funding raised to $285M. Already profitable, Fresha is using this investment to accelerate global expansion and drive the next generation of AI and product innovation.

Today, Fresha operates at global scale, with offices across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. Our platform is trusted by **130,000+ beauty and wellness businesses across 120 countries**, with more than **1.5 billion appointments booked** to date.

Our mission is simple: **help beauty and wellness businesses grow by giving them the technology they need to attract clients, manage their operations and run their business in one place.**

We’re continuing to scale rapidly across markets, teams and products, making this an exciting time to join us.

##### **Role Overview**

**Head of Corporate Learning and Education | London | Office-based 5 days per week |**

As Fresha continues to scale globally, we’re looking for a **Head of Corporate Learning and Education to build our company-wide learning function from the ground up.**

You’ll design the frameworks, curriculums and systems that help every Fresha employee build the knowledge and skills they need to succeed. From new joiner onboarding and role-specific learning pathways to product education and career development, you’ll create a scalable learning infrastructure that grows with the business.

Working closely with leaders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, Customer Support, People and our wider global organisation, you’ll turn knowledge into structured learning experiences and ensure our teams stay educated as Fresha continues to evolve.

##### **What You’ll Do**

* **Build Fresha’s Learning Framework:** Design and own our global learning strategy, governance and standards, creating a scalable foundation for how employees learn and develop across the business.
* **Create Role-Specific Curriculums:** Build structured learning pathways across teams including Commercial, Product & Engineering, Customer Support, People and Finance, tailoring content and specialisations to each function.
* **Own New Joiner Learning:** Design and continuously improve Fresha’s onboarding and induction learning journey so employees have the knowledge and context they need from day one.
* **Lead Product Education:** Partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to create learning programmes around new releases, product updates and platform changes, keeping teams current as Fresha evolves.
* **Turn Knowledge into Scalable Learning:** Work with department leaders and subject matter experts to capture internal expertise, best practice and tribal knowledge and convert it into structured, engaging learning content.
* **Build the Learning Technology Stack:** Select, implement and manage the Learning Management Systems and tools required to deliver, track and scale learning globally.
* **Measure Learning Impact:** Define KPIs across completion, knowledge retention, behavioural change and business outcomes, using data to continuously improve programmes and demonstrate impact.
* **Connect Learning to Career Growth:** Partner with the People Team to build skills frameworks and career pathways that connect employee development with progression opportunities.
* **Build and Lead the Function:** Hire, develop and coach a high-performing team of learning and instructional design professionals as the function scales.

##### **What We're Looking For:**

* **Learning & Development Leadership:** 5+ years of experience leading Corporate Education or Enablement within a fast-paced SaaS, technology or digital marketplace business.
* **Framework Builder:** A proven track record of designing and implementing learning frameworks, curricula and learning pathways across multiple functions and levels of seniority.
* **Product Education Experience:** Strong experience partnering with Product teams to translate new features, product changes and complex information into effective employee learning.
* **Instructional Design Expertise:** Strong understanding of adult learning principles and how to create engaging programmes that drive knowledge retention and behavioural change.
* **Learning Technology Experience:** Confident evaluating, implementing and managing Learning Management Systems and modern learning tools.
* **Data-Driven Mindset:** Comfortable defining learning KPIs, measuring programme effectiveness and using data to guide learning investment and improvement.
* **Senior Stakeholder Influence:** Strong ability to partner with and influence senior leaders while building effective relationships across multiple functions.
* **Leadership & Coaching:** Experience building or leading teams, developing others and maintaining a high bar for learning quality.
* **Builder Mentality:** Highly proactive, comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the opportunity to create something from the ground up rather than inherit an established function.
* **High Ownership:** A hands-on self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, solves problems creatively and is willing to roll up their sleeves to deliver.

##### **Your Opportunity at Fresha:**

* **Build the Function from Zero:** Create Fresha’s global learning infrastructure from the ground up and establish how learning operates across the company.
* **Shape How Fresha Scales:** Build the programmes that help employees ramp faster, understand our product deeply and perform at a higher level as the business grows.
* **Influence Across the Business:** Partner directly with leaders across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Customer Support, People and other global functions.
* **Own Global Product Education:** Play a central role in ensuring Fresha employees understand our rapidly evolving product and can confidently communicate its value.
* **Build Your Team:** Grow and lead the learning function as Fresha continues expanding across markets, teams and products.
* **Create Lasting Impact:** Build frameworks, systems and learning experiences that become part of how Fresha develops its people for years to come.

##### Benefits

* **Private Healthcare & Wellbeing:** Fully covered private health insurance after probation, confidential counselling, in office Mat Pilates three times a week and a Friday Run Club.
* **EV Salary Sacrifice Scheme:** Save on the cost of leasing an electric vehicle through our salary sacrifice scheme after probation.
* **Annual Leave:** 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays.
* **Pension:** 3% employer contribution when you contribute 5%.
* **Perks & Discounts:** Access to premium wellness products, services and everyday discounts through Circular Benefits.
* **Food & Refreshments:** Complimentary daily snacks and drinks, plus a fully catered lunch every Friday, and breakfast on Monday.

# Non-Executive Director and Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee

United Kingdom

## Description

**About GB Group plc**

GB Group plc (“GBG”) is listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250.

GBG serves customers across the Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific through two highly complementary core capabilities of identity and location. Together, these enable organisations to accurately verify identities, prevent fraud and better understand customers, driving the vast majority of our revenues across diverse, regulated and data rich markets.

We deliver our capabilities through a scalable, technology-led platform that supports local market requirements while benefiting from global expertise. Our commercial model is largely based on subscription and consumption contracts, reflecting how embedded our solutions are in our customers’ critical workflows.

This underpins our strong levels of repeatable revenue, stable margins and high cash generation, enabling us to continue investing in product innovation and go-to-market activities globally.

### The Requirement

GBG is led by an experienced Board chaired by Richard Longdon and, as a FTSE 250 company, operates within a more mature governance and reporting framework. The Board is supported by an Audit & Risk Committee with a central role in overseeing financial reporting, internal controls, risk management, external audit and the wider control environment.

The Company is seeking to appoint a high-calibre independent Non-Executive Director who can provide strong financial, governance and risk oversight and chair the Audit & Risk Committee. The successful candidate will bring credibility with investors and other stakeholders and be comfortable operating in a UK listed company environment.

The appointment calls for an individual with recent and relevant financial experience, sound judgement, independence of mind and the ability to support and challenge management constructively in a complex, international, data-led technology business.

The role will require the usual commitment expected of a non-executive director of a FTSE 250 company, including attendance at scheduled Board and Committee meetings and sufficient availability outside formal meetings to support the Chair, executive leadership team and key governance processes. The board typically meets ten times a year, split between the company’s headquarters in Chester and London (one board meeting may be held internationally). The anticipated time commitment is approximately 20 days per year, and the role is paid a base salary of £63,549 with an additional fee for Audit & Risk Committee Chair of £20,000 pa.

### The Successful Candidate

Candidates will have the integrity, independence, sound judgement and personal credibility required of an independent non-executive director of a UK Main Market listed company, together with the stature to chair the Audit & Risk Committee effectively.

In addition to the required ‘recent and relevant’ financial experience, the successful candidate is likely to bring broad international experience from a technology, software, data, digital, payments or other regulated services environment. They will understand the governance, reporting and control expectations of a FTSE 250 business and be capable of adding value in a complex, international, data-led organisation.

The appointee will be expected to contribute meaningfully to Board discussions on strategy, performance, capital allocation, financial reporting, risk management, internal control and assurance. They should be well placed to support the Board and executive team as the Company continues to strengthen its control environment and reporting in line with Main Market expectations, including the evolving requirements of the UK Corporate Governance Code.

They will have strong interpersonal skills, the confidence to engage effectively with Board and management colleagues, and the ability to challenge constructively while maintaining supportive and collaborative relationships. The right candidate will be commercially minded, strategically astute and capable of contributing as a rounded business leader and Board director, in addition to bringing the technical credibility required of an Audit & Risk Committee Chair.

### Skills Required

More specifically, the following skills and experience are sought:

·       The necessary ‘recent and relevant’ financial experience to chair the Audit & Risk Committee effectively, with a strong grasp of financial reporting, significant judgements, internal controls, risk oversight, treasury, capital allocation and the external audit process. A professional accounting qualification is likely to be advantageous.

·       A track record in a senior executive leadership role, ideally including listed company Board exposure, with many strong candidates likely to have served as a CFO, divisional CFO or in another role with direct responsibility for financial stewardship, controls and risk.

·       A successful executive track record in a relevant sector, with experience of businesses operating at scale in technology, software, data, digital identity, fraud, payments, compliance or adjacent regulated markets likely to be particularly valuable.

·       An understanding of customer use cases and regulatory expectations in areas relevant to GBG, including identity verification, fraud prevention, financial crime, compliance, data governance and trusted digital transactions.

·       Breadth of commercial and strategic experience that would add value to Board discussions, including familiarity with one or more of GBG’s key end markets such as financial services, gaming, e-commerce, public sector or other highly regulated customer segments.

·       Experience of operating in international businesses across multiple jurisdictions, with an appreciation of the governance, regulatory, compliance and control challenges that arise in both mature and growth markets.

·       A thorough understanding of the role of an independent non-executive director in a UK Main Market listed company, including high standards of corporate governance, financial reporting, internal control, risk management and shareholder accountability, together with awareness of current UK Corporate Governance Code expectations.

·       Credibility with investors, the external auditor and other key stakeholders, together with the judgement and communication skills to chair an effective committee, handle sensitive issues appropriately and support robust but constructive debate.

·       The independence, availability and commitment required to be a fully engaged Board member and committee chair, including sufficient time for meetings, preparation and ad hoc discussions outside the formal meeting cycle.

·       An appreciation of the discipline, governance rigour and stakeholder expectations that come with serving on the Board of a FTSE 250 company, while retaining the commercial perspective, pragmatism and balanced judgement needed to support a growth-oriented international business.

The boardroom style of the individual will also be a relevant consideration in this appointment. The board enjoys an open, direct and collegiate culture, in which every director is offered an opportunity to have their say. It is a small board that zeroes in quickly on the challenges and opportunities facing the business, offering practical support and constructive challenge to the executive team.

GBG is mindful of the value that diversity can bring to the board. While gender diversity is a critical consideration, the company is also interested in individuals whose age, experience, or nationality can bring a different perspective and outlook to board discussions.

### To find out more

As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Please inform your GBG Talent Attraction Partner if you require any reasonable adjustments to the interview process.

To chat to the Talent Attraction team and find out more about our benefits and why we’re a great place to work, drop an email to behired@gbgplc.com and we’ll be in touch. You can also find out more about careers at GBG and check out our current opportunities at gbgplc.com/careers.

# Principal Site Reliability Engineer (we have office locations in Cambridge, Leeds and London)
