# Delivery Lead - AI & Innovation (12 month Contract)

London, United Kingdom

## Job Description

**Who we're looking for**

We're looking for an AI Delivery Lead to turn high-value Applied AI opportunities into real, measurable outcomes across Schroders. This is a chance to shape how AI agents take their place alongside our people: moving from promising experiments to capabilities that colleagues across the firm depend on every day.   
  
You'll own delivery end to end: bringing structure to fast-moving, ambiguous work, aligning multidisciplinary teams, managing risk and dependencies, and holding a firm line on the value we set out to create. It calls for strong facilitation, stakeholder management and prioritisation skills, and the judgement to apply just enough process to keep pace without losing control.   
  
AI is a firm-wide priority at Schroders, with senior sponsorship, serious investment and real appetite to move. If that's the kind of environment you want to deliver in, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
**About Us**

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.  
  
Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.  
  
**The team**

The AI and Innovation team is Schroders' centre of excellence for AI. We build the enterprise AI services and agentic platform that let AI agents deliver value at scale, and we partner with teams right across the firm to take their highest-value use cases from first idea into production.

This is a high-priority, high-visibility area using genuinely new technology, and we move quickly against competing demands. You'd join a small team of people who care about software in a financial context and are set on keeping Schroders ahead of the curve.  
  
**What you'll do**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Applied AI use cases across Schroders, from discovery and shaping through to production adoption and benefit realisation.
* Turn agreed business intent into credible delivery plans, working with sponsors and teams to sequence the work, set milestones, expose dependencies and agree decision points. Get dependent work onto the backlogs and roadmaps of other teams early enough to matter.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across product, engineering, architecture, data, security, risk, operations and business areas, ensuring delivery remains aligned to agreed outcomes.
* Remove blockers for the team, actively manage risks and issues, and escalate clearly where decisions, trade-offs or support are needed.
* Steer use cases through relevant governance, keeping approvals moving and proving a solution is ready before it reaches production.
* Use data, feedback and delivery metrics to communicate progress, evidence value, identify friction, and adapt plans where assumptions are not holding.
* Facilitate challenging discussions, create shared understanding between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and make sure decisions are understood even where agreement is not possible.
* Drive continuous improvement in execution, using metrics, retrospectives and feedback to improve delivery flow, team performance, knowledge sharing and self-organisation.

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need**

* Proven experience leading end-to-end delivery of complex technology, digital, data or AI-enabled initiatives in a multidisciplinary environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build trust, manage competing priorities, negotiate trade-offs, and challenge assumptions constructively.
* Experience owning delivery plans and managing risks, issues, dependencies, governance and reporting in a way that supports pace without losing control.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align business, technical and control stakeholders around shared purpose, practical plans and clear decisions.
* Practical knowledge of Agile, Lean or related delivery approaches, with the judgement to adapt practices to different types of work rather than applying process mechanically.
* Experience using evidence, metrics, feedback and retrospectives to improve delivery flow, adoption, value realisation and team performance.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, with genuine curiosity about what they can and can't do and the instinct to test the claims rather than take them at face value.
* A track record of advocating for AI, bringing colleagues with you and helping teams get real value from the tools available to them.

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications that will help**

* Experience delivering applied AI, automation, data, analytics or workflow transformation use cases in a regulated enterprise environment.
* Familiarity with responsible AI delivery considerations, including evaluation, human oversight, model limitations, data access, security, privacy, auditability and operational readiness.
* Experience working across several business domains at once, balancing competing demand while keeping teams focused on the highest-value outcomes.
* Experience leading change and adoption activities, helping business teams prepare for new ways of working and measuring whether the intended impact has been achieved.
* Experience working with enterprise controls such as identity, access management, data classification, retention, approvals, operational risk, service management or third-party governance.
* Experience coaching teams or colleagues in delivery practices, stakeholder engagement, work management, facilitation, governance or continuous improvement.
* An understanding of modern AI delivery patterns, including LLM-enabled workflows, agentic systems, tool integration, evaluation approaches, and the practical risks of moving from prototype to production.
* Experience leading teams where engineers work with AI-assisted development tools, and an appreciation of how that changes planning, estimation, review and quality control.
* Active contribution to delivery communities, shared standards, reusable patterns, mentoring, continuous learning and knowledge sharing.

**What you'll be like**

* A delivery leader who creates clarity in ambiguity, keeps teams focused on outcomes, and brings enough structure to move at pace without creating unnecessary process.
* Confident working across business, technology and control teams, with the judgement to listen well, challenge constructively, and make progress where priorities compete.
* A skilled facilitator who can bring different viewpoints together, surface trade-offs, and catalyse groups towards clear decisions and ownership.
* Resilient and calm under pressure, able to support teams through uncertainty, change and difficult decisions.

## About the role

As SSS continues to grow, our platform needs to integrate effectively with more external systems, operational processes need to become increasingly automated, and technical issues need to be easier to identify and resolve.

We are looking for a Software Automation & Integration Engineer to work across software engineering, integrations and technical operations.

The role will focus on connecting systems, automating repetitive work and improving the reliability of our platform and supporting processes.

This is not a traditional feature-development role or a first-line support position. It is suited to someone who enjoys identifying the underlying cause of technical problems and implementing robust, maintainable solutions.

## Key responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

* Building and maintaining integrations with external platforms
* Automating repetitive operational processes
* Monitoring APIs, integrations, queues and scheduled jobs
* Investigating technical failures and recurring issues
* Building internal tools that make problems easier to diagnose and resolve
* Creating reusable patterns for future integrations
* Contributing to our Laravel application where integration or automation work requires it

Everything you build should be secure, tested, observable and maintainable.

## Integrations and automation

A significant part of the role will involve connecting SSS with external screening providers, client systems and SaaS platforms.

You will work with technologies including:

REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON, background jobs, queues and data flows.

You will also work with operational teams to identify processes that could be improved through automation.

The objective is not simply to automate for the sake of it. Solutions should remove meaningful manual work, reduce errors, improve service or enable the business to scale more effectively.

Depending on the requirement, the appropriate solution may be part of the Laravel application, a lightweight service, a script or an automated workflow.

We favour the simplest solution that remains secure, observable and maintainable.

## Technical reliability

You will help investigate and resolve technical issues affecting integrations, automation and supporting systems.

This may include:

* Tracing API requests
* Examining logs
* Investigating failed webhooks
* Diagnosing queue or scheduled job failures
* Investigating unexpected data states
* Supporting technical incident investigation

Where possible, recurring problems should be detected earlier, monitored more effectively, automated or engineered out rather than repeatedly worked around.

## Engineering environment

You will write production code and work alongside our Software Engineers where integrations, automation or reliability requirements touch the core application.

Our engineering practices include:

* Git
* Pull requests
* Code review
* Testing
* CI/CD
* Controlled production changes

Our technology stack includes:

* PHP / Laravel
* React
* MySQL
* Laravel Vapor / AWS

Automation and integration work is expected to meet the same engineering standards as our core product development.

## Skills and experience

We are looking for someone who:

* Has professional experience in backend software development, integrations or automation
* Is comfortable working with PHP/Laravel, MySQL and SQL
* Understands REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, webhooks and OAuth
* Has experience with queues, scheduled jobs and background processing
* Can investigate technical issues using logs, errors and system behaviour
* Understands Git, CI/CD, testing and safe production changes
* Can read unfamiliar code and understand how systems fit together
* Is comfortable working with cloud infrastructure and modern delivery tooling such as AWS and Laravel Vapor
* Can communicate technical problems clearly

Strong software engineering fundamentals are more important than experience with every technology in our stack.

We are particularly interested in people who enjoy turning recurring technical problems into permanent solutions.

Engineers may use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Codex where they improve the quality or efficiency of their work.

This is an operations-led position. You will be working day to day on AWS, our infrastructure-as-code, our CI/CD setup, observability, and the on-call rotation.

A meaningful part of the work is automation: when we find ourselves doing the same thing twice, we usually invest in tooling rather than writing another runbook. Most of that tooling is written in Go.

* We also expect candidates to learn quickly. The stack and the company both move, and you will regularly be the first person on the team to take on something new.

## Who we are

### About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

### About the team

Payments Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who lead and advise on opportunities for some of the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. We work alongside Stripe’s Core Sales and Customer Success teams to help users adopt products that improve payment experiences, increase conversion, support international growth, and create new sources of revenue.

We are hiring an Account Executive, Product - Local Payment Methods to grow adoption of Stripe’s local payment methods across EMEA. This role will work across Stripe’s global LPM portfolio while developing particular expertise in the payment preferences, market dynamics, and user opportunities most relevant to Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The role will initially emphasize Stripe’s largest European markets and the markets where local payment preferences are most pronounced—including the UK and Ireland, DACH and Switzerland, Benelux, the Nordics, Southern Europe, and selected Central and Eastern European markets—while supporting priority growth opportunities in the Middle East and Africa.

## What you’ll do

As an Account Executive, Product focused on Local Payment Methods, you will be a quota-carrying product-sales overlay responsible for growing adoption and revenue across new and existing Stripe users. You will partner with Core Account Executives and Customer Success Managers throughout the sales cycle—from opportunity identification and discovery through business-case development, commercial negotiation, technical validation, implementation, activation, and expansion.

You will help some of Stripe’s largest and most sophisticated users understand how regionally relevant payment methods can support conversion, customer choice, global expansion, and sustainable revenue growth for users and payment-method partners. You will develop deep knowledge of Stripe’s portfolio and the payment behaviors that shape commerce across EMEA, including bank-based payment methods, wallets, and other country-specific payment experiences.

You are an adept salesperson who can engage in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of an organization. * 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, partnerships, or a closely related commercial role at a technology company, with a track record of strong performance against goals.

* Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

operate, and continuously improve distributed systems in production.

  observable, and scalable (latency, throughput, reliability).

  background workers, and idempotent processing.

  (if applicable), and systematic improvements (SLOs, error budgets, runbooks).

  strategy, and operational best practices.

  observability patterns across the platform.

  and iterate quickly based on real usage.

  long-term technical direction.

* **Senior experience (typically 8+ years)** building and operating backend systems in  
  production.

  consistency tradeoffs, schema evolution, failure modes.

  cloud components, scaling patterns, cost awareness.
* **Kubernetes and Docker** experience: containerized services, deployments, operational  
  workflows.

  (Datadog and/or OpenTelemetry experience is a plus).
* **Databases**: strong PostgreSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning) plus  
  comfort working with OpenSearch and modern data stores.
* **Engineering rigor**: testing strategies (unit, integration, contract), CI/CD hygiene, safe  
  rollout patterns (feature flags, canaries, gradual releases).

### Bonus

* Experience with **queueing and streaming systems** (SQS, SNS, Kafka, Kinesis,  
  RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub).
* **Vector databases** and retrieval patterns (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant,  
  OpenSearch vector).
* Redis, MongoDB (only if truly used and not just “resume keywords”).
* Terraform (or equivalent IaC), GitHub Actions (or similar CI/CD).
* Security basics for backend systems (authn/authz, secrets management, least privilege,  
  threat-aware design).

## What success looks like

* Services that are easier to operate: clear SLOs, better alerts, faster incident resolution.
* Higher throughput and lower latency as usage grows.
* Stronger platform foundations: repeatable patterns for async processing, observability,  
  and safe deployments.
* A team that levels up through your mentorship and technical leadership.

### Ideally, you are someone that

* Has previously worked in startups - comfortable navigating some uncertainty and high  
  energy environments
* Enjoys the collaborative process with different roles to design, implement and iterate on

* Is not a perfectionist but has a mindset of continuous, incremental improvements  
  towards top-quality work
* Is great at communicating with engineers, product managers, and other team members

The analyst supports pre- and post-trade analysis of Portfolio Manager activity to make full use of the ETF vehicle’s capabilities, while serving as a business owner for the data that enables ETF trading, primary-market activity, portfolio implementation and oversight.

The role requires expertise in ETF mechanics—including creation/redemption activity, basket construction, spreads, premiums/discounts and indicative values—together with a strong understanding of tax lots, tax-lot harvesting and relevant security-level tax considerations. Consistent with the broader Trading Solutions model, data ownership is a core responsibility rather than a downstream support activity. The analyst defines business requirements and data standards, establishes accountability for critical ETF data, monitors quality and controls, prioritizes remediation and enhancement work, and partners with Technology and data-producing/consuming teams to evolve the ETF data model and strategic roadmap. The objective is to create trusted, reusable data foundations that reduce implementation risk, support automation and analytics, and enable the ETF platform to scale.

·         Support creation/redemption and basket-related analysis, including the evaluation of primary- versus secondary-market implementation and opportunities to improve tax efficiency and reduce transaction costs.

·         Contribute to the development and implementation of tax-efficient trading solutions across investment vehicles, including mutual-fund RIK capabilities.

·         Apply modelling, statistics, optimization and programming to solve investment implementation problems and automate repeatable analytical workflows.

  

**ETF Data Ownership and Governance**

·         Act as a business data owner/domain owner for ETF Trading Solutions, with accountability for the fitness, usability and appropriate governance of critical ETF data used in investment and trading workflows.

·         Define and maintain business definitions, data requirements, critical data elements, ownership and stewardship expectations, lineage needs, quality standards and control requirements for ETF data domains.

·         Establish and monitor data-quality measures and controls; investigate exceptions, coordinate root-cause analysis and drive remediation with Technology, Operations, vendors and other data-producing teams.

·         Own the business prioritization of ETF data defects, enhancements and strategic initiatives, balancing investment impact, operational risk, scalability and platform growth.

·         Represent ETF Trading Solutions in data governance forums and ensure business decisions, standards and ownership are clearly documented and communicated.

·         Partner with Technology to develop and evolve the ETF data strategy, target data model, APIs and reusable data services, with clear business acceptance criteria and validation of delivered solutions.

·         Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate data acquisition, transformation, validation and distribution, reducing manual intervention and implementation risk.

·         Ensure new ETF products and capabilities have appropriate data readiness, controls and operating ownership before launch and as they scale.

  

**Analytics, Technology and Platform Development**

·         Build and maintain analytical tools and data pipelines supporting ETF implementation, monitoring and decision-making.

Lead the business design and implementation of a scalable ETF reconciliation/data-quality platform, working with our Technology partners to build out the supporting tooling, controls, and exception workflows.

·         Develop metrics and management information that make data quality, process health, implementation outcomes and platform scalability visible to stakeholders.

  

**Subject Matter Expertise, Communication and Partnership**

**Skills and Experience to Succeed in the Role**

·         Strong understanding of ETFs and their primary- and secondary-market mechanics; knowledge of tax-lot optimization and tax-efficient portfolio implementation is highly desirable.

Orpington, England, United Kingdom

# Client Director

## Own strategic client partnerships, shape high-value transformation opportunities and drive sustainable growth at Tecknuovo alongside senior leaders and expert delivery teams.

### About the role

As a **Client Director** at Tecknuovo, you will own and grow a portfolio of strategic client relationships, helping organisations solve complex challenges through technology and transformation.

Sitting within our Engagement Hub, you will be responsible for understanding our customers’ priorities, identifying where Tecknuovo can add meaningful value, and turning those opportunities into long-term partnerships and sustainable commercial growth.

You will hold overall accountability for the success and growth of your accounts. Depending on the size and complexity of the portfolio, you may lead Client Partners who focus on the day-to-day management and success of live Statements of Work, or you may retain direct responsibility across the full client lifecycle yourself.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders across our customers and with our Delivery and Technical teams to shape solutions that deliver measurable outcomes. From developing new relationships through to growing established accounts, you will provide strategic and commercial leadership throughout the client lifecycle.

This is a senior role with significant autonomy and influence. You will help shape how Tecknuovo goes to market, strengthen our position with customers and ensure our growth remains aligned with our North Star and Values.

### Key responsibilities

* Own the overall success and growth of a portfolio of high-value client accounts, developing deep relationships and creating sustainable commercial growth.
* Shape and lead strategic account plans, identifying opportunities to expand existing relationships and develop new areas of business.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite and senior stakeholders, developing a strong understanding of their organisations, transformation priorities and challenges.
* Identify, shape and convert new opportunities, translating complex customer needs into commercially viable, outcome-led propositions.
* Maintain strategic oversight of live engagements, ensuring delivery continues to support customer outcomes, account growth and long-term relationships.
* Where appropriate, lead and support Client Partners responsible for the day-to-day management of live SOWs, providing direction, coaching and escalation while retaining overall accountability for the account.
* Where accounts do not require dedicated Client Partner support, take direct ownership of the client relationship across both live engagements and future growth opportunities.
* Work closely with Delivery, Technical and wider internal teams to design and mobilise services that deliver measurable outcomes for our customers.
* Provide strategic and commercial oversight across Statements of Work, ensuring propositions deliver clear customer value while supporting Tecknuovo’s commercial objectives.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the technology, digital transformation and competitive landscape, using this insight to inform customer conversations and identify emerging opportunities.
* Strengthen Tecknuovo’s position in the market by helping articulate our impact through customer success stories, case studies and thought leadership.
* Ensure client and commercial activity aligns with Tecknuovo’s North Star, operating model and Values.

### Who you are and how you’ll make an impact

You will bring significant experience in technology consulting or digital transformation, with a strong track record of developing strategic client relationships and growing complex enterprise accounts.

You understand how to move beyond traditional supplier relationships and become a trusted strategic partner. You are comfortable operating with senior business and technology leaders, asking the right questions to understand their priorities and translating those conversations into opportunities that deliver value for both the customer and Tecknuovo.

You have experience shaping technology services and solutions, taking opportunities from early-stage conversations through proposition development, commercial discussions and mobilisation. You understand the balance between customer outcomes, delivery feasibility and commercial performance and can make sound judgements across all three.

You are comfortable operating at different levels within an account: maintaining the strategic customer relationship and identifying future opportunities while retaining visibility of live delivery. You know when to stay close to the detail and when to empower others, and may have experience leading account or client management teams within larger portfolios.

Commercially, you have a demonstrable record of delivering against revenue targets and growing accounts over time. You are comfortable developing account strategies, navigating complex organisations and identifying where relationships can be expanded.

You communicate with credibility and clarity at executive level and are equally effective working across multidisciplinary internal teams. You create alignment around opportunities, provide direction where needed and bring structure to complex or fast-moving situations.

You are highly autonomous and comfortable operating in a scale-up environment where priorities can evolve quickly. You maintain a strong understanding of the changing technology landscape and use that knowledge to strengthen customer conversations and identify where Tecknuovo can make a meaningful difference.

Experience working across both public and private sector organisations would be valuable, particularly where you have developed an understanding of their different commercial, procurement and regulatory environments.

### A day in the life

Your day might begin with a conversation with a senior customer stakeholder about their transformation roadmap, exploring an emerging challenge and where Tecknuovo could support.  
  
You could then catch up with a Client Partner on one of your larger accounts, reviewing the health of live SOWs, customer feedback and any areas requiring your support, before turning your attention to the account’s wider growth plan and upcoming opportunities.  
  
On another account, you might be closer to the day-to-day relationship yourself, working directly with Delivery and Technical colleagues to ensure a live engagement is progressing successfully while continuing to build relationships and identify what comes next.  
  
Later, you might bring together colleagues from Engagement, Delivery and Technical to shape a new opportunity, present a proposition to executive stakeholders or work through the commercial and delivery considerations needed to mobilise a new engagement.  
  
Across the week, you will balance the strategic growth of your portfolio with oversight of live client relationships, adapting your level of involvement depending on the size, maturity and needs of each account.

**📈 Who We Are:**

**We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.**

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a **$75 million Series B -** led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

## 🚀 The Role

We're hiring a People Operations Partner to join our Performance team.

tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. Core People operations needs more firepower as we scale, and there's a direct commercial angle too: a strong People Operations function is what lets new joiners ramp up and become productive faster once they arrive.

This is a multi-disciplinary People Operations role at the centre of the employee lifecycle - equal parts operational delivery, automation and continuous improvement. You'll be the reliable hands keeping People processes running as we scale, from multi-country payroll to onboarding, employee changes and offboarding. You'll also build the tools, automations and lightweight AI workflows that connect our systems (Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n and Google Workspace), so the function doesn't need to double in size every time headcount does.

In your first 12 months, you might:

* Take ownership of payroll across our UK and employer-of-record employees, keeping every cycle accurate and on time as pay schedules and countries multiply.
* Become the trusted point of contact for employees and managers, owning their queries through to resolution.
* Build the automations and AI-enabled workflows that remove repetitive manual work from the employee lifecycle.
* Turn recurring pain points into better processes, tools or self-service, and measure whether they actually worked.
* Move across People disciplines as priorities shift - reward and benchmarking, pensions and options administration, performance cycles, engagement and people data.

## 🛠️ Responsibilities

* **Run payroll end to end:** own monthly payroll across UK and employer-of-record employees - changes, corrections, off-cycle and ex-gratia payments, contractor payroll and invoicing, and country-specific items - keeping it accurate and on time as we add pay schedules and countries.
* **Keep the lifecycle running:** deliver core People operations across onboarding, employee changes, contracts and documentation, leave, mobility (visas and international moves), EOR and contractor setup, and offboarding, flexing into whatever the business needs most.
* **Be the trusted point of contact:** own employee and manager queries through to resolution with a clear response standard, rather than passing them between functions.
* **Keep the foundations accurate:** maintain employee data, documentation and systems so that everything else can depend on them.
* **Automate the repeatable:** build and maintain automations and lightweight AI-enabled tools, workflows and agents that connect Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n, Google Workspace and similar, and remove repetitive manual work - with controls so speed never costs accuracy, privacy or employee trust.
* **Own the People tech stack:** evolve our People technology ecosystem - evaluate emerging tools, consolidate where we can, and simplify the architecture.
* **Improve continuously:** turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, measure whether they worked, and give foundational People processes a named owner and a runbook someone else could follow cold.
* **Design to delight and to scale:** we treat our people like top athletes and aim to delight at every step of the employee journey, and what works at today's size shouldn't need twice the People team when headcount doubles - default to eliminating or automating work rather than administering it.
* **Partner across the business:** work with Finance, Legal, Talent, Performance Partners and functional specialists to turn People initiatives into scalable services, and build dashboards and lightweight analysis that help the team and the business make better decisions.

## ✅ Requirements

**Must-Haves**

* You've worked in People Operations, People Services, HR Operations or another operational People role - generalists welcome - and you hold a high bar on accuracy and confidentiality.
* You've run payroll cycles end to end, ideally multi-country, in-house or through an employer of record. UK fundamentals (PAYE, RTI, pension auto-enrolment, statutory payments) are familiar, or clearly learnable fast if your payroll experience comes from another market.
* You're highly comfortable with technology: AI is part of how you work, you actively experiment with new tools and capabilities, and you can build automations through no-code or low-code tools, integrations and AI workflows.
* You think in systems and workflows rather than individual tasks, with a strong instinct for simplification ("why are we doing this manually?"), and you're comfortable using data to diagnose problems and make decisions.
* You operate effectively in ambiguity, without waiting for a perfectly defined process or remit, and you balance efficiency with empathy - People Operations is about people, not just workflows.
* Strong ownership instincts: when something's broken, unclear or inefficient, your instinct is to fix it, and you're willing to move across People disciplines depending on where the organisation needs you.

**Desirable**

* Breadth across the People remit beyond Operations - reward and benchmarking, pensions, benefits, or performance and engagement. This role is deliberately multi-disciplinary.
* Familiarity with the basics of UK and EU employment law, and experience administering equity or share options (for example EMI or unapproved schemes, and cap-table tools such as Vestd).
* Experience supporting international employment through employers of record, and setting up or managing contractors (including off-payroll and IR35 awareness).
* Experience in a fast-scaling startup or scale-up, especially through a period of doubling headcount or entering new countries.

## 🎁 Benefits & Perks

* Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.
* 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.
* Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

* Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.

* Hiring Manager interview.

If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.*

## Job description

***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. ***Innovate with Tether***

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

Professional services is a core part of the FT’s global corporate coverage and this reporter will be expected to break news on the big strategy and IT consultancies, particularly McKinsey, Boston Consulting Group, Bain and Accenture, as well as contributing to covering the advisory operations of the Big Four – Deloitte, EY, KPMG and PwC. 

Working closely with our other professional services reporters, in London and New York, the correspondent will chart how AI is reshaping the sector globally. The technology threatens to wipe out parts of consultants’ businesses and kill off their traditional hourly billing model. But executives argue that the upheaval also presents a massive opportunity for the sector as companies seek advice on how to overhaul their IT, workforces and strategies. 

There is scope to break stories about job cuts and changes to the sector’s staffing model as firms respond to sluggish demand and turn to AI to do tasks previously carried out by armies of junior consultants. The role will involve working with the FT’s global network to dig into how AI is disrupting IT consulting firms’ lucrative business implementing enterprise software products from the likes of SAP and Salesforce. 

The reporter must be able to deliver scoops and inside-the-room insight on the executives who run the big consultancies, their pay and C-suite power dynamics within the firms. The professional services sector has long been a source of regulatory and reputational scandals, while the incursion of private equity has fuelled the growth of challengers to the dominant players, offering great scope for original reporting that can attract readers to the FT. 

You will have to work closely with colleagues from across the newsroom, particularly the US Professional Services Editor and the London-based Accountancy Correspondent. You will also be expected to contribute across different media as the FT expands its professional services coverage. 

**Key responsibilities**

* Bring in high-profile scoops about the big professional services firms on issues such as: work won and lost, financial performance, strategic changes, adoption of AI and technology, behaviour and workplace culture, regulatory interventions, leadership changes and M&A.
* Deliver deeply reported analyses on the changing business models of professional services groups, their business relationships with AI, tech and software groups and their importance in wider society.
* Be the first to report on the roles of consultants in big corporate stories in other sectors, such as turnaround plans and strategic overhauls at blue-chip companies.
* Weekend shifts are required as part of the newsroom rota.
* Working with, and providing cover for, reporters on the professional services team during absences.

**Please submit your application by the end of the day, Monday 12th October 2026.**

**The use of AI**

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

**Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion**

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

**What’s in it for you? Our benefits**

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

**Accessibility**

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

**Who We Are**

We’re here to build a network the UK can count on – one that connects people, places and potential. Because no matter where you live, what your background is, or how you get online – we think everyone deserves the same chance to stay connected, and with VodafoneThree, that future’s being built – today.

We’re creating more than the UK’s best network. We’re helping close the digital divide, empower communities and drive meaningful progress.

You’ll join a team that genuinely cares – about each other, about our customers, and about the future we’re building. From day one, you’ll be welcomed, valued and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

**Why VodafoneThree**

Join us and you’ll be at the heart of change. That means building responsibly, investing sustainably and creating opportunities that last.

We’re not just expanding connectivity; we’re reimagining what a connected nation looks like. With £11bn invested in 5G and digital infrastructure, your work will directly power businesses, services, and communities across the country.

You’ll work on real challenges, with real impact, across every corner of the country. Wherever you join us, whatever your role, you’ll be helping to build a future that works better for everyone.

We move at pace, because what we’re building matters – and we’re learning as we go. We’re proud of the progress we’ve made, but we’re just getting started.

Join us at the heart of our business in the Regulatory, Government Affairs and Company Secretary team, one of the central support functions that underpin our business and keep us moving forward. We provide centralised support, expertise and guidance across our UK operations, continuing to build on our success and trailblazing the way to our next stage of digital growth.

  

Job Description

  

**What you’ll do**

This role involves providing high-quality, expert, practical, legal and regulatory advice across VodafoneThree's consumer and enterprise business, enabling regulatory compliant customer propositions and communications. The role supports the design and delivery of compliant customer journeys and contributes to embedding regulatory governance in commercial decision making.

The Senior Counsel acts as a trusted advisor to  commercial, product and marketing teams, translating complex regulatory obligations into clear and actionable guidance. You will business partner and act as a key regulatory advisor on consumer-facing proposition design, terms and conditions and communications.

The ideal candidate will be a senior qualified lawyer or highly experienced regulatory advisor with significant experience in UK consumer protection law and Ofcom regulatory frameworks. They should have a deep understanding of telecoms products, customer journeys and the regulatory and legal frameworks that govern them. The role demands exceptional communication skills and gravitas, the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, and a proven track record of successfully designing and implementing compliant product journeys and governance frameworks. KPIs include customer journey compliance, regulatory sign-off SLA, enforcement risk management, and integration compliance.

* **Regulatory implementation:** Support the design, development and delivery of compliant customer journeys, propositions, and communications across VodafoneThree consumer and business brands, ensuring compliance with Ofcom and CMA roles. Ensure that approach aligns to strategic goals.

* **Advisory & Documentation:** draft, review and approve customer-facing materials ensuring they meet business and regulatory requirements. Provide specialist expert counsel on consumer law and regulation.

* **Commercial Governance:**Participate in proposition and pricing approval forums, ensuring regulatory and legal issues are identified early and managed effectively.

* **Integration Compliance:** Support the integration of Vodafone and Three consumer products and systems, identifying regulatory risks and ensuring consistent compliance standards are applied across legacy businesses.

* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Work collaboratively  with colleagues in Legal, Regulatory Policy, Product, Marketing and Operations to implement practical compliance solutions and foster a culture of proactive regulatory delivery.

* **Regulatory Enforcement support:** Assist in management regulatory engagement, investigations and complaints, preparing legal responses and briefing materials as required.

* **Continuous Improvement:**Help evolve playbooks, templates, and guidance notes to improve consistency, efficiency and understanding of regulatory requirements across the business.

  

Qualifications

  

**Who you are**

* Senior qualified lawyer or highly experienced senior regulatory advisor with significant experience working within a specialist legal/regulatory delivery team advising on UK consumer protection law and Ofcom regulatory frameworks.
* Deep understanding of telecoms products, customer journeys, and the regulatory and legal frameworks that govern them.
* Demonstrated ability to embed regulatory obligations into commercial and operational processes at scale. Skilled in balancing compliance requirements with commercial and operational realities.
* Experience in regulatory enforcement, including advising on complaints, investigations and dispute resolution.
* Proven ability to lead complex legal/regulatory workstreams related to product integration, proposition development and go-to-market delivery and a track record of successfully designing and implementing compliant product journeys and governance frameworks.

You'll also play a key role in maintaining the wider financial crime control framework, translating policy requirements into practical, well-governed controls, and supporting risk management across our financial crime operations.

Monitoring regulatory developments (FCA, HM Treasury, OFSI, JMLSG and other relevant bodies) and translating changes into timely policy and procedure updates.
* Partnering with Ongoing Monitoring Operations & Product Teams, Second Line of Defence, and Risk teams to ensure policies are operationally workable and embedded in day-to-day practice.
* Supporting internal audits, regulatory examinations, and assurance reviews with policy documentation, control evidence, and subject matter expertise.

* Experience designing or maintaining a financial crime control framework and supporting risk management activity.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to operate and influence at senior  level across Compliance, Risk, and the wider business.
* Excellent analytical and drafting skills — able to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable policy.
* Experience with regulatory horizon scanning, gap analysis, and remediation planning.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with competing priorities.

## **The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay**

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

## Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

## Key Responsibilities

* Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.

* Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
* Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
* Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.

## Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

* Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
* Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
* The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.

# Recovery Worker - City and Hackney - Criminal Justice

### Job Introduction

Do you want to help build a brighter future for communities and individuals in Hackney doing a highly rewarding job. Turning Point’s drug & alcohol services are currently expanding during a very exciting time in the sector with new funding and investment. We have a range of roles for people passionate about supporting others to make change.

 This will be working predominantly with a specific cohort of clients who are involved in the criminal justice system. This will include supporting clients in their transition to community-based substance services from prisons, ensuring a smooth continuity of care, as well as holding a caseload of clients who are on probation and subject to community treatment requirements. There will be safeguarding and clinical risks that need to be effectively mitigated, and the worker will play a key role in identifying the correct pathways that we offer in City & Hackney. We are looking for a non-judgemental, friendly and hardworking individual that can build safe and trusting relationships with Vulnerable Adults in a fast-paced sector.

 You will have opportunities to progress your career with a structured learning journey and clearly defined career pathways that will enable you to achieve your long-term goals and work to your strengths.

Whether you are looking to progress into a management and leadership role or to be a specialist in your field as an Advanced Substance Use Practitioner at Turning point we will support and encourage you on your career journey.

### Role Responsibility

Ensuring strength-based recovery plans are developed in the service that are;

* Comprehensive, person-centred, individualised and based on clear assessments of clients’ needs and circumstances.
* Reflect the structure and aims of SM’s Models of Psychosocial Interventions.
* Reflect the involvement of individuals and their family/advocates.
* Supported by accurate, person-centred and individualised risk assessments.
* Help to ensure the delivery of excellent person-centred interventions with individuals for whom we provide support.

Recovery workers act as ‘key workers’ to a caseload of service users, supporting them to decide their goals around treatment and develop plans to achieve these. The role includes maintaining regular contact with your clients, offering advice, information and psycho-social interventions as well as providing assessments, risk management planning and working closely with our clinical staff around prescribing needs. Recovery workers will have frequent professional liaison with partner agencies such as, but not limited to, prisons, probation, courts, police, neighbouring substance use service, housing, social services, and medical professionals (hospitals / CMHT / GPs).

No day is the same in this role but an ability to communicate effectively with a range or service users and colleagues, an ability to manage different tasks and a commitment to Turning Point values are essential. You may have lived experience of substance use/mental health/homelessness (self or a significant other), come with experience supporting people in health and social care or just have a keen interest in supporting this group; if your values are right, we have a role for everyone.

### The Ideal Candidate

You’ll have an understanding of both substance use and the criminal justice system and the challenges and opportunities for individuals on a recovery journey. However, we also recognise that many people have transferrable skills from other backgrounds such as criminal justice, mental health, housing or other health and social care provision. The roles are varied, so flexibility, an ability to work dynamically on a one to one and group basis and knowledge of relapse and other barriers to recovery will be vital but we can help to shape these skills where needed. We also look for candidates with excellent communication skills and who share our values as an organisation. We value individuals with lived experience but also those who are just interested in this line of work; our Trainee Recovery Worker program enables individuals without all relevant experience to gain an entry level position within the organisation before moving on to other roles.

We value individual creativity and initiative and, whatever your role, you will be fully involved in identifying opportunities to improve the quality of our services and the service user experience. ## Job Description

Research Technician – Cryo-EM / Structural Biology LMS 2961  
£37,476 - £39,470 per annum, inclusive of London Allowance  
12-month Fixed term | Full time | Location: Hammersmith London 

**Overall purpose:**

We are looking for a talented structural biologist to join the DNA Motors group headed by Professor Luis Aragon at the MRC Laboratory of Medical Sciences (LMS) and Imperial College London, working on a translational cryo-EM project.

The DNA Motors group studies the Structural Maintenance of Chromosomes (SMC) complexes – cohesin, condensin and SMC5/6 – using cryo-EM, single-molecule biophysics, biochemical reconstitution and cell biology. Through the LMS–Imperial Drug Discovery Hub, we are running a drug discovery programme targeting the cohesin subunit STAG1, a synthetic-lethal vulnerability in STAG2-mutant cancers such as bladder cancer, Ewing sarcoma and myeloid malignancies. The post-holder will lead the structural arm of this programme during the screening and hit-development phase: producing STAG1 and STAG1-containing cohesin complexes, determining cryo-EM structures of these assemblies alone and bound to screening hits, and using this structural information to define binding sites, validate hits and guide compound optimisation together with our medicinal chemistry and drug discovery partners.

The ideal candidate will have a background in structural biology, with hands-on expertise in single-particle cryo-EM and prior experience working on SMC protein complexes.

**Main duties / key responsibilities:**

* Express and purify recombinant STAG1, cohesin and related SMC complexes (e.g. insect cell and E. coli systems) for structural and biophysical studies
* Prepare, screen and optimise cryo-EM grids, and collect cryo-EM data using local and national facilities
* Carry out single-particle image processing, 3D reconstruction, model building and refinement, including fitting and validation of bound small molecules
* Determine structures of STAG1/cohesin complexes with screening hits to define binding modes and support structure-guided hit development
* Contribute to hit validation using complementary biochemical and biophysical assays of compound binding
* Work closely with medicinal chemists, the Drug Discovery Hub team and external partners, communicating structural results to inform compound design
* To plan and carry out research in accordance with the project aims
* Take initiatives in the planning of research
* Conduct and plan own scientific work with appropriate supervisor

* To take an active part in the academic activities of the LMS
* To attend and contribute to journal clubs and seminar presentations
* Presentation of data at national and international meetings
* To form good working relationships with other members of the group as well as internal and external collaborators
* To assist others and co-supervise students when required

# **Product Manager**

  

Uniware Systems Limited is a division of Vesta Software, an operating group of Constellation Software Inc., and is a UK market leader established in 1993, providing EPoS, Payments and digital solutions across catering, retail and hospitality environments.

  

We support a broad range of customers including universities, financial institutions, motorway services, professional services organisations and other major businesses across the UK.

  

Uniware is entering an important phase in the development of its products and delivery model, including the adoption of AI-DLC across product discovery, definition, construction, testing, documentation and handover.

  

**The Position**

  

Reporting to the **Business Unit Leader**, this role will take ownership of product direction across Uniware’s software portfolio.

  

The Product Manager will develop a deep understanding of our customers, users and markets; identify and validate product opportunities; shape product vision, strategy and roadmap; and work across Development, QA, Commercial, Account Management, Support and other teams to ensure we build products that create customer and commercial value.

  

The Product Manager will own the product-management lifecycle from **strategy and opportunity identification through discovery, prioritisation, definition, delivery, launch, measurement and continuous improvement**.

  

The focus is not simply on managing development requests or maintaining a backlog, but on ensuring Uniware understands the right problems to solve, defines successful outcomes clearly and follows products through to successful customer adoption.

  

The role will also play a key part in Uniware’s AI-DLC approach, using AI to improve customer discovery, ideation, requirements definition, prototyping and product delivery while retaining clear human ownership of product decisions.

  

**Job Purpose**

  

* Develop and maintain product vision, strategy and roadmap across the Uniware portfolio.
* Develop a strong understanding of customer needs, market opportunities, competitive positioning and product performance.
* Lead structured product discovery with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Identify and prioritise new products, features and product improvements.
* Define clear customer outcomes, requirements, user journeys and acceptance criteria before construction begins.
* Ensure user experience and usability are treated as core product requirements.
* Lead Product participation throughout the AI-DLC process.
* Work collaboratively across the business to ensure delivered solutions remain aligned with agreed product outcomes.
* Support successful launches, Early Adopter activity and wider product adoption.
* Define and monitor appropriate product success measures and use evidence to inform future product decisions.
* Manage the product lifecycle, including opportunities to enhance, consolidate, replace or retire products and features.

  

**Job Responsibilities**

  

* Gather, analyse and prioritise requirements from customers, prospects and internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate customer interviews, workshops, product walkthroughs, roadshows and structured discovery sessions.
* Identify the underlying customer problem rather than relying solely on requested features.
* Combine qualitative customer research with product usage, support data, commercial feedback, market information and other available evidence.
* Maintain and communicate a clear product roadmap aligned with company strategy and commercial priorities.
* Assess opportunities based on customer value, commercial potential, strategic fit, delivery feasibility, risk and evidence.
* Define product scope, user journeys, requirements, acceptance criteria and measurable success outcomes.
* Lead the Product contribution to AI-DLC ideation and inception activities.
* Use AI tools to support research, discovery, analysis, prototyping, requirements definition and documentation.
* Use AI responsibly in line with company requirements relating to confidentiality, data protection, security, intellectual property and human review.
* Ensure significant projects enter construction with sufficient clarity around the customer problem, expected outcome, user journey and requirements.
* Ensure relevant security, performance, reliability, accessibility, compliance, implementation, support and operational requirements are considered during product definition.
* Work closely with Development to ensure technical decisions continue to support the agreed customer and product outcome.
* Ensure significant product or UX changes during construction are explicitly discussed, understood and recorded.
* Work with QA to ensure delivered functionality can be validated against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain visibility of delivery progress, risks, blockers and expected delivery.
* Work with Commercial and Account Management to understand customer segments, market demand, competitive positioning, pricing considerations and opportunities for product growth.
* Support business cases for significant product investment, including expected customer value, commercial opportunity, assumptions and risks.
* Support product positioning, internal enablement, demonstrations and customer communications for significant launches.
* Lead Product involvement with **Early Adopter customers**, actively gathering feedback, identifying usability issues and undetected faults, and coordinating with the relevant teams to ensure material issues are understood, prioritised and resolved quickly.
* Use Early Adopter feedback and initial product-performance data to determine whether changes are required before wider rollout.
* Define and monitor appropriate product health and success measures, including relevant customer, usage, support and commercial evidence.
* Regularly assess the health, strategic relevance and commercial performance of products and significant product areas.
* Use this evidence to refine existing products and inform future roadmap priorities.
* Maintain awareness of competitor products, market trends and emerging technologies.
* Communicate product decisions, priorities, rationale and changes clearly to relevant stakeholders.

  

**Decision Responsibilities**

  

The Product Manager will be accountable for recommendations and decisions relating to:

* Customer problem definition.
* Product vision, strategy and roadmap recommendations.
* Product scope and intended outcomes.
* Product requirements.
* User journeys and intended user experience.
* Product priorities.
* Acceptance criteria.
* Customer validation.
* Product success measures.

  

Development remains accountable for technical architecture, implementation approach and engineering standards.

  

Product, Development and QA will work collaboratively on feasibility, delivery trade-offs and readiness.

Where demand exceeds available capacity, competing priorities should be surfaced and consciously prioritised rather than being resolved informally.

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Strong understanding of user experience and the importance of UI/UX in product development.

## Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer, Vinted Pay

* Engineering

## **Brief info about Vinted**

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.   
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:  
  
**Vinted Marketplace** is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.  
  
**Vinted Go** enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.  
  
**Vinted Pay** is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.  
  
Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

## **Information about the position**

As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Pay, you will be the staff-level security engineer inside our regulated payments business - and the person who makes Vinted Pay's security posture match its growth. Vinted Pay is a rare security problem in the best sense: a fintech scaling across multiple European licences at marketplace speed, where security cannot be a compliance checklist or an isolated engineering task - it has to be built into the core financial architecture. Its attack surface spans multi-region AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines and payment pages, wallets holding members' money, the cardholder and personal data behind them, and a regulatory perimeter - PCI DSS, DORA, Bank of Lithuania and FCA rules - that rises every year.

Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in the Payments Engineering leadership team, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services (pentesting, threat intelligence, SSDLC tooling, compliance), while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Pay already owns part of its local execution; your job is to lead and scale it - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate: translate regulatory requirements into technical guardrails and drive practical controls alongside Vinted Pay's platform and software engineers. You will work directly with Vinted Pay's Director of Engineering and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Platform.

This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself and setting direction for the security work already under way, and as the function matures you will shape and functionally lead Vinted Pay's security engineering capability.

## **In this position, you’ll**

* Own the Vinted Pay security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - a multi-quarter roadmap that shapes how Vinted Pay defends its infrastructure and payment assets, rather than reacting to the next audit.
* Turn regulation into engineering: map PCI DSS, DORA, and Bank of Lithuania and FCA requirements into practical, automated security controls and engineering guardrails - compliance as a by-product of how Vinted Pay builds, not a parallel workstream.
* Find and close the operational blind spots: run deep technical reviews of our AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines, SIEM and logging, and vulnerability management tooling (e.g. Wiz), and fix what you find - prioritised by exposure, not by finding count.
* Own PCI DSS and data protection architecture: payment page isolation, script monitoring, data encryption, and least-privilege access across multi-region environments - and turn those controls into evidence that stands up to assessors and regulators.
* Lead cross-functional security initiatives across Payments Platform, Payments Engineering, and Group Security, and drive them to delivery - whether execution sits with partner teams or you have to write the code yourself.
* Act as the technical arm of Vinted Pay's security accountable: maintain the risk register, prepare mitigation-or-acceptance decisions against centrally set thresholds, and represent Vinted Pay in the group's security governance.
* Embed secure development into Payments engineering so security lands at design time rather than after deployment, and raise the security fluency of Vinted Pay engineers so risk-based decisions happen well without you in the room - security as a delivery enabler, not a gate.

## **About you**

* Strong hands-on security engineering experience on a real engineering foundation - you have built or run large production systems, and you can threat-model a payment flow, find the attack path yourself, and drive or build the fix.
* Experience in regulated payments or fintech - you have worked under PCI DSS and a financial regulator (FCA, Bank of Lithuania, CSSF, or equivalent) and know how their requirements become controls engineers actually run.
* A staff- or principal-level track record - you have defined, led, and delivered major, company-wide technical initiatives, and you set security direction through software design on high-scale, distributed systems rather than from the outside.
* The range to move across the four archetypes of staff engineering - tech lead, architect, solver, right hand - picking the one the domain needs together with the Director of Engineering, not the one you prefer.
* A way of working that engineers respect: evidence over assertions, attack paths over checklists, guardrails over gates.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and translate technical risk into business consequence for senior audiences, internal and external.
* Comfortable in our stack - Ruby on Rails, Go, MySQL, Temporal, AWS, SIEM and CSPM tooling - or eager to learn it, with a real interest in security and privacy as a field and the appetite to keep growing as an engineer and leader.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Advantage: experience building and running systems at massive scale (2+ million requests per minute), deep knowledge of observability tooling (Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus), and a passion for introducing new practices.
* Advantage: AWS security depth (IAM, KMS, multi-account and multi-region architecture), or hands-on CSPM (e.g. Wiz) and SIEM engineering.
* Advantage: privacy engineering experience, or offensive security background or certifications (e.g. OSCP).

If this role excites you but you don't tick every box, we'd still like to hear from you.

## **Work perks**

* 25 working days of holiday
* Newest MacBook models
* Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
* Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
