Virtasant is a global cloud and technology services company helping organizations modernize, optimize, and build at scale. We work with enterprise customers on complex cloud, data, infrastructure, and AI initiatives, bringing together deep technical expertise and hands-on delivery.

### About the Role

We’re looking for a **Senior Serverless Spark Migration Engineer** to help modernize a large-scale enterprise data platform.

You’ll lead the migration of production **Apache Spark workloads from on-premise Hadoop/Spark environments to cloud-native and serverless architectures across AWS and GCP**. This is a hands-on engineering role spanning workload assessment, architecture, application refactoring, migration execution, performance optimization, automation, and production readiness.

The goal is not simply to lift and shift existing workloads. You’ll determine the right target architecture for each workload and establish repeatable patterns that can eventually support migration at significant enterprise scale.

### What You’ll Do

* Lead migrations of enterprise Spark workloads from on-premise environments to **AWS and GCP**.
* Assess Spark applications, clusters, configurations, dependencies, data flows, and resource utilization.
* Determine the right migration approach across **rehost, replatform, refactor, modernize, or retire**.
* Modernize traditional cluster-based workloads for **serverless Spark** where appropriate.
* Design and implement architectures using technologies such as **AWS EMR Serverless, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, GCP Dataproc Serverless, GCS, and BigQuery**.
* Refactor legacy **PySpark/Scala/Spark SQL** applications for cloud portability, scalability, and reliability.
* Migrate workloads from environments using **Hadoop, HDFS, YARN, Hive, and on-prem Spark clusters**.
* Troubleshoot and optimize Spark workloads across partitioning, shuffle behavior, joins, data skew, execution plans, executor configuration, serialization, and SQL execution.
* Benchmark performance and optimize serverless workloads for **performance, reliability, and cloud cost**.
* Build reusable migration tooling, automation, templates, and frameworks.
* Implement CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code using tools such as **Terraform**.
* Define testing, validation, cutover, rollback, observability, and production-readiness patterns.
* Partner with Data Engineering, ML, Cloud Architecture, Platform Engineering, DevOps/SRE, Security, Governance, and FinOps teams.

### What We’re Looking For

* **8+ years** of experience across data engineering, distributed systems, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.
* **5+ years of hands-on Apache Spark experience** in enterprise environments.
* Strong **PySpark and/or Scala** development experience.
* Proven experience migrating **large-scale Spark workloads between infrastructure platforms**.
* Hands-on experience with **both AWS and GCP**.
* Experience with **on-premise Hadoop/Spark ecosystems**, including technologies such as HDFS, YARN, and Hive.
* Deep understanding of **Spark internals and distributed processing**.
* Strong SQL and data engineering fundamentals.
* Experience with cloud data lakes and object storage.
* Strong production troubleshooting and performance-tuning experience.
* Experience with **CI/CD, Git, and Infrastructure as Code**.
* Ability to own migration work end-to-end, from discovery and architecture through production cutover and optimization.

### Nice to Have

## **The Team**

Wavel is building the leading regulated crypto and payments platform in the UK. The UK is moving from MLR registration to a full FSMA authorisation regime, and we are moving with it. # Graduate Analyst Programme - Healthcare Strategy & Operations

## Values-led. Pace-driven. Be an exceptional graduate shaping operational excellence in private healthcare. Where judgement, delivery and disciplined performance differentiate.

### Graduate Analyst Programme - Healthcare Strategy & Operations

**London | November Start**

Welbeck is looking for ambitious graduates with strong data analytics skills and hands-on Power BI experience. Over 12 months, you will use data to help leaders make better decisions about healthcare capacity, workforce, investment and patient experience.

You will work directly with operational leaders, clinicians and executives across our London, Oxford and Cambridge centres, taking responsibility for analysis that informs real decisions. You will work on live projects rather than rotating between departments. Expect complex questions, imperfect information and the chance to see your recommendations put into practice.

### **What you will do**

· **Dashboards.** Build clear, interactive Power BI dashboards that bring together operational, workforce and commercial data to track performance and highlight where action is needed.

· **Data people can trust.** Clean, combine and validate data from multiple sources, define consistent measures and document assumptions so colleagues can trust and reproduce your analysis.

· **Workforce and performance.** Analyse trends in retention, productivity and service performance, test possible explanations and distinguish evidence from assumption.

· **Capacity and patient flow.** Evaluate opportunities to expand capacity and improve theatre utilisation and patient flow, balancing commercial value with patient safety and experience.

· **Investment cases.** Model the financial and operational impact of investment and process changes, testing how different assumptions affect the recommendation.

· **Recommendations**. Present concise recommendations to senior leaders, explain the limitations of the evidence and help measure whether agreed changes deliver the intended improvements.

### **What you will gain**

You will build commercial judgement, a practical understanding of how healthcare services operate and experience in business intelligence, strategy and operational improvement. Working with leaders and clinicians, you will learn to frame the right question, defend your analysis and communicate findings to people with different priorities.

This is a fixed-term programme. Graduates who perform strongly will be may be considered for permanent roles in analytics, strategy or operational management as they arise.

### **What you will bring**

We are looking for analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and sound judgement. Your evidence can come from university projects, a dissertation, internships, employment or personal projects. Prior healthcare experience is not required.

### **Essential**

· **Power BI.** Hands-on experience building clear, interactive Power BI reports.

· **Data analysis.** Cleaning and validating data, investigating trends and outliers, applying sound statistical reasoning and turning findings into recommendations.

· **Excel.** Formulas, lookups and pivot tables, with the ability to check calculations and build structured models.

· **Communication.** Explaining complex findings simply, with effective visuals, and answering questions about your methods and assumptions.

· **Judgement**. Challenging assumptions, working through ambiguity and knowing when more evidence or guidance is needed.

· **Care.** Attention to detail, resilience and discretion with confidential information.

**Desirable**

· **Advanced Power BI.** Power Query, data modelling and table relationships, and DAX measures.

· **Coding**. SQL, Python or R.

· **A quantitative degree.** STEM or another quantitative discipline.

### Our values

Our values, CAKE, shape how we work and how we hire. This is what they mean in this role.

· **Collaboration.** “We share skills and knowledge in the pursuit of the greater good.” You will agree measures with clinical, operational and finance colleagues, so everyone uses the same numbers.

· **Ambition.** “We are open to new ideas and speak up when we see better ways of working.” You will question how things are measured and propose better ways to track and improve performance.

· **Kindness.** “We are thoughtful, respectful and show consideration to those around us.” Behind every data point is a patient or a colleague, so you will handle data and findings with care.

· **Empowerment.** “We create a safe space to try, learn and excel.” You will own your analysis from question to recommendation, with room to try new approaches and learn.

**Minimum eligibility**

· A 2:1 undergraduate degree (upper second-class honours) or equivalent, in any discipline.

· The right to work in the UK from November 2026 for the full programme. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship.

· Available to start in November 2026 and work full time, with three days a week on site in London.

· Able to attend the in-person assessment day in London.

· Support the Head of Guest Experience with the coordination and delivery of GX projects, initiatives and strategic priorities across Welbeck.

We are looking for an experienced **growth and lifecycle marketer** who knows how to take strong marketing and make sure it reaches the right people, through the right channels, at the right moment.

Different people. Different behaviours. Different reasons to care.

* Processing deliveries efficiently and ensuring that on the shop floor products are replenished and always available for customers
* Supporting in stock management processes such as stocktakes.
* Using company resources such as the White Stuff website, Looking White Stuff, the Tea Room, email communications, window guidelines and brand posts to engage with our customer and ensure compliance with daily/weekly actions.

* Understanding and complying with the Health & Safety and emergency procedures in store.
* Having a professional approach to our internal customers, head office departments, centre management (where applicable) and any other visitors.
* Efficient and accurately fulfilling ship from store and Click + Collect processes.

**Doing Good Stuff**

* Holding an awareness of our charity partner and the positive impact this has including supporting any events or charity promotions.
* Understanding our approach to ethical sourcing and environmental impact to be able to explain this to our customers and the team.

* Up to 25 days holiday per annum plus bank holidays
